model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_wall.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='address',
    settings={'allow_nullable_key': 1},
    tags=['production','execution','gpay']
  )
}}


{% set spender     = '0x4822521e6135cd2599199c83ea35179229a172ee' %}

WITH operational AS (
    SELECT lower(address) AS address
    FROM {{ source('crawlers_data', 'gpay_operational_wallets') }}
),

activated_wallets AS (
    SELECT
        "from"      AS pay_wallet,
        MIN(date)   AS activation_date
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_transfers_whitelisted_daily') }}
    WHERE "to" = '{{ spender }}'
      AND date >= toDate('2023-12-01')
    GROUP BY "from"
    HAVING pay_wallet NOT IN (SELECT address FROM operational)
),

safe_setup AS (
    SELECT
        safe_address,
        MIN(block_timestamp) AS creation_time
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_safes_owner_events') }}
    WHERE event_kind = 'safe_setup'
      AND safe_address IN (SELECT pay_wallet FROM activated_wallets)
    GROUP BY safe_address
),

base AS (
    SELECT
        s.safe_address    AS address,
        a.activation_date AS activation_date,
        s.creation_time   AS creation_time
    FROM safe_setup s
    INNER JOIN activated_wallets a
        ON a.pay_wallet = s.safe_address
),

-- June 2026 post-exploit migration: NEW Safes inherit the OLD Safe's
-- activation_date so cohort/retention dates do not reset; creation_time
-- is the migration completion. New Safes whose old Safe never activated
-- stay out (the registry remains payment-gated, same as before).
migrated_in AS (
    SELECT
        lower(m.new_safe_address)                                 AS address,
        b.activation_date                                         AS activation_date,
        toDateTime64(parseDateTimeBestEffort(m.completedAt), 0, 'UTC') AS creation_time
    FROM {{ source('crawlers_data', 'gp_migrated_safes') }} m
    INNER JOIN base b
        ON b.address = lower(m.old_safe_address)
)

SELECT
    address,
    min(activation_date) AS activation_date,
    min(creation_time)   AS creation_time
FROM (
    SELECT address, activation_date, creation_time FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT address, activation_date, creation_time FROM migrated_in
)
GROUP BY address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_safe.name: int_execution_gpay_safe_switchover
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_safe.description:
One row per June 2026 migrated pair. Refunded (is_lost) pairs are
excluded from user holdings from first_refund_at (the first refund from
the verified distributor 0xbb897a56...); non-refunded pairs have no
cutover - their old safe counts until the user moves the funds.
is_lost + first_refund_at are the reusable lost-safes filter;
new_safe_deployed_at is informational.

new_safe.name: new_safe
new_safe.description: NEW Safe address the pair migrated to (lowercase).

new_safe_deployed_at.name: new_safe_deployed_at
new_safe_deployed_at.description: On-chain SafeSetup time of the new Safe (seed completedAt fallback).

first_refund_at.name: first_refund_at
first_refund_at.description: First refund date from the verified distributor; NULL when the pair was never refunded.

is_lost.name: is_lost
is_lost.description: 1 when the pair received a refund (old-safe funds were lost and made whole).

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_safe.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='old_safe',
    settings={'allow_nullable_key': 1},
    tags=['production','execution','gpay']
  )
}}

-- One row per migrated pair. Cutover applies ONLY to refunded ("lost")
-- pairs: the refund injects replacement funds while the old safe may keep
-- residuals, which are recovery-entitled from first_refund_at onward.
-- Non-exploited pairs have NO cutover - their funds count wherever they
-- physically sit, and the old safe drains naturally when the user moves
-- them (many pairs have a deployed new safe but funds not yet moved).
-- new_safe_deployed_at is informational.
-- CH LEFT JOIN fills '' / zero-date on misses, hence the explicit guards.

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT
        lower(old_safe_address)                                AS old_safe,
        lower(any(new_safe_address))                           AS new_safe,
        min(toDateTime64(parseDateTimeBestEffort(completedAt), 0, 'UTC')) AS completed_at
    FROM {{ source('crawlers_data', 'gp_migrated_safes') }}
    GROUP BY lower(old_safe_address)
),

deployments AS (
    SELECT lower(address) AS new_safe, min(start_blocktime) AS deployed_at
    FROM {{ ref('contracts_safe_registry') }}
    GROUP BY lower(address)
),

refunds AS (
    SELECT new_safe, min(refund_date) AS first_refund_date
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_refunds') }}
    GROUP BY new_safe
)

SELECT
    p.old_safe                                                        AS old_safe,
    p.new_safe                                                        AS new_safe,
    if(d.deployed_at != toDateTime64(0, 0, 'UTC'), d.deployed_at, p.completed_at)
                                                                      AS new_safe_deployed_at,
    if(r.first_refund_date != toDate(0), r.first_refund_date, NULL)   AS first_refund_at,
    toUInt8(r.first_refund_date != toDate(0))                         AS is_lost
FROM pairs p
LEFT JOIN deployments d ON d.new_safe = p.new_safe
LEFT JOIN refunds r     ON r.new_safe = p.new_safe

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_cove.name: int_execution_gpay_coverage_daily
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_cove.description:
Per-day, per-(`conversion_kind`, `identity_role`) tracked-coverage
stats. Same shape as `int_execution_gnosis_app_coverage_daily` with
the GP role dimension added so persona can compare owner-grain
coverage against treasury-grain coverage for the same conversion
kind.

"Tracked": ≥1 row in `int_execution_gpay_user_events_unified` where
`event_ts < conversion_ts`, `event_ts >= conversion_ts - 30d`,
`identity_role` matches the conversion's role, and `event_kind` is
not the conversion's own mapped event_kind (leakage guard via
`conversion_kind_to_event_kind`).

Incremental, monthly partition on `conversion_date`. Uses
`grace_hash` join algorithm in pre-hook.

conversion_date.name: conversion_date
conversion_date.description: Calendar date of the conversions being summarised.

total_conversions.name: total_conversions
total_conversions.description: Number of conversions on (date, kind, role).

tracked_conversions.name: tracked_conversions
tracked_conversions.description: Subset with ≥1 prior-30d non-self touch in the same role.

total_users.name: total_users
total_users.description: Distinct converting users on (date, kind, role).

tracked_users.name: tracked_users
tracked_users.description: Distinct converting users with ≥1 prior-30d non-self touch.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_cove.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='(conversion_date, conversion_kind, identity_role)',
    partition_by='toStartOfMonth(conversion_date)',
    settings={'allow_nullable_key': 1},
    tags=['production', 'mta', 'execution', 'gpay'],
    pre_hook=["SET join_algorithm = 'grace_hash'"],
    post_hook=["SET join_algorithm = 'default'"]
  )
}}
{% set start_month = var('start_month', none) %}
{% set end_month   = var('end_month',   none) %}

-- Per-day, per-(conversion_kind, identity_role) coverage stats. Same
-- shape as the GA-side coverage_daily, with the role dimension added so
-- the persona can compare "owner-grain coverage" vs "treasury-grain
-- coverage" for the same conversion_kind.

WITH conv AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_conversions') }}
    WHERE conversion_date < today()
      AND identity_role != 'delegate'
    {% if start_month and end_month %}
      AND toStartOfMonth(conversion_date) >= toDate('{{ start_month }}')
      AND toStartOfMonth(conversion_date) <= toDate('{{ end_month }}')
    {% else %}
      {{ apply_monthly_incremental_filter('conversion_date', 'conversion_date', add_and=True) }}
    {% endif %}
),

active_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudonym, identity_role FROM conv
),

events AS (
    SELECT e.user_pseudonym, e.identity_role, e.event_ts, e.event_kind
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_user_events_unified') }} e
    INNER JOIN active_users u
        ON e.user_pseudonym = u.user_pseudonym
        AND e.identity_role = u.identity_role
    WHERE e.event_date >= (SELECT min(conversion_date) FROM conv) - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND e.event_date <= (SELECT max(conversion_date) FROM conv)
),

tracked AS (
    SELECT
        c.conversion_date,
        c.conversion_kind,
        c.identity_role,
        countDistinct(c.user_pseudonym, c.conversion_ts) AS tracked_conversions,
        uniqExact(c.user_pseudonym)                      AS tracked_users
    FROM conv c
    INNER JOIN events e
      ON  e.user_pseudonym = c.user_pseudonym
      AND e.identity_role  = c.identity_role
      AND e.event_ts       <  c.conversion_ts
      AND e.event_ts       >= c.conversion_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND e.event_kind     != {{ conversion_kind_to_event_kind('c.conversion_kind') }}
    GROUP BY c.conversion_date, c.conversion_kind, c.identity_role
),

total AS (
    SELECT
        conversion_date,
        conversion_kind,
        identity_role,

-- Per-day, per-(conversion_kind, identity_role) coverage stats. Same
-- shape as the GA-side coverage_daily, with the role dimension added so
-- the persona can compare "owner-grain coverage" vs "treasury-grain
-- coverage" for the same conversion_kind.

WITH conv AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_conversions`
    WHERE conversion_date < today()
      AND identity_role != 'delegate'
    
      
  
    
    
    
    
    
    

    AND 
    
      
      toStartOfMonth(toDate(conversion_date)) >= (
        SELECT toStartOfMonth(addDays(max(toDate(x1.conversion_date)), -0))
        FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_coverage_daily` AS x1
        WHERE 1=1 
      )
      
    
  

    
),

active_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudonym, identity_role FROM conv
),

events AS (
    SELECT e.user_pseudonym, e.identity_role, e.event_ts, e.event_kind
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_user_events_unified` e
    INNER JOIN active_users u
        ON e.user_pseudonym = u.user_pseudonym
        AND e.identity_role = u.identity_role
    WHERE e.event_date >= (SELECT min(conversion_date) FROM conv) - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND e.event_date <= (SELECT max(conversion_date) FROM conv)
),

tracked AS (
    SELECT
        c.conversion_date,
        c.conversion_kind,
        c.identity_role,
        countDistinct(c.user_pseudonym, c.conversion_ts) AS tracked_conversions,
        uniqExact(c.user_pseudonym)                      AS tracked_users
    FROM conv c
    INNER JOIN events e
      ON  e.user_pseudonym = c.user_pseudonym
      AND e.identity_role  = c.identity_role
      AND e.event_ts       <  c.conversion_ts
      AND e.event_ts       >= c.conversion_ts - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND e.event_kind     != 
  multiIf(
    c.conversion_kind = 'topup',                 'chain.topup',
    c.conversion_kind = 'swap_filled',           'chain.swap_filled',
    c.conversion_kind = 'token_offer_claim',     'chain.token_offer_claim',
    c.conversion_kind = 'marketplace_buy',       'chain.marketplace_buy',
    c.conversion_kind = 'gpay_payment',          'gp.payment',
    c.conversion_kind = 'gpay_funded',           'gp.deposit',
    c.conversion_kind = 'gpay_cashback_claim',   'gp.cashback_claim',
    'unknown'
  )

    GROUP BY c.conversion_date, c.conversion_kind, c.identity_role
),

total AS (
    SELECT
        conversion_date,
        conversion_kind,
        identity_role,
        count()                  AS total_conversions,
        uniqExact(user_pseudonym) AS total_users
    FROM conv
    GROUP BY conversion_date, conversion_kind, identity_role
)

SELECT
    t.conversion_date,
    t.conversion_kind,
    t.identity_role,
    t.total_conversions,
    coalesce(tr.tracked_conversions, 0) AS tracked_conversions,
    t.total_users,
    coalesce(tr.tracked_users, 0)       AS tracked_users,

    coalesce(tr.tracked_users, 0)       / nullIf(t.total_users, 0)       AS tracked_user_coverage
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN tracked tr USING (conversion_date, conversion_kind, identity_role)

model.gnosis_dbt.contracts_gpay_modules_.name: contracts_gpay_modules_registry
model.gnosis_dbt.contracts_gpay_modules_.description:
Registry of the Zodiac module proxies whose events Gnosis Pay models
decode: every proxy ever enabled on a GP Safe, plus the Spender
singletons.

Per-card modules (Delay, Roles) need two agreeing evidence sources,
joined on the proxy address:
  1. int_execution_safes_module_events — the Safe enabled this address
     as a module (filtered to GP Safes via int_execution_gpay_wallets).
  2. int_execution_zodiac_module_proxies — the address was deployed by
     the canonical Zodiac ModuleProxyFactory and points at one of the
     known per-card GP mastercopies.
The INNER JOIN means we drop any "enabled module" event that points to
an address we don't recognise as a Zodiac proxy of a GP-relevant type.

The Spender is registered on factory discovery ALONE, because it is a
singleton enabled on GP's infra safes rather than on any card safe —
the per-card filter above is structurally incapable of admitting it,
and requiring it kept int_execution_gpay_spender_events empty from
2023-12 onward. Keyed on its two mastercopies (0x70db5361...,
0x7a592bae...), which share a byte-identical ABI.

This is the high-quality registry that decode_logs consumes via
contract_address_ref to decode per-module events downstream.

Output schema matches the standard contracts_*_registry shape so
decode_logs picks up abi_source_address automatically.

address.name: address
address.description: Module proxy address (lowercase, 0x-prefixed). Used as the address filter against execution.logs.

abi_source_address.name: abi_source_address
abi_source_address.description: The Zodiac mastercopy address — where the ABI lives in event_signatures.csv. Lowercase, 0x-prefixed.

start_blocktime.name: start_blocktime
start_blocktime.description: Earliest block at which this proxy was enabled on a GP Safe.

model.gnosis_dbt.contracts_gpay_modules_.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='(address)',
    settings={ 'allow_nullable_key': 1 },
    tags=['production','execution','gpay','registry']
  )
}}

WITH gpay_safes AS (
    SELECT lower(address) AS pay_wallet
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_wallets') }}
),

-- Every (module_proxy, first_enabled_at) pair that was enabled on a GP Safe.
enabled_on_gp AS (
    SELECT
        lower(target_address) AS module_proxy,
        min(block_timestamp)  AS first_enabled_at
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_safes_module_events') }}
    WHERE event_kind = 'enabled_module'
      AND lower(safe_address) IN (SELECT pay_wallet FROM gpay_safes)
      AND target_address IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY module_proxy
),

-- Same proxies, joined to the Zodiac factory discovery so we know
-- which mastercopy each one points at, and therefore the contract type.
typed AS (
    SELECT
        e.module_proxy                                                 AS address,
        multiIf(
            p.master_copy = '0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5', 'DelayModule',
            p.master_copy = '0x9646fdad06d3e24444381f44362a3b0eb343d337', 'RolesModule',
            p.master_copy = '0x732b9e9f259fba6f65a1a012dc89c20872ffbd2f', 'RolesModule',
            'Unknown'
        )                                                              AS contract_type,
        p.master_copy                                                  AS abi_source_address,
        toUInt8(1)                                                     AS is_dynamic,
        e.first_enabled_at                                             AS start_blocktime,
        'gpay_module_enabled_x_proxy_factory'                          AS discovery_source
    FROM enabled_on_gp e
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_zodiac_module_proxies') }} p
        ON p.proxy_address = e.module_proxy
    -- 0x732b9e9f... = post-June-2026-migration Zodiac Roles mastercopy (71,425 new card proxies), so the
    -- allowances / spender-delegate models see migrated cards. The migration's new DELAY mastercopy
    -- 0x22d903fd... is intentionally NOT registered: registering it would give migrated safes a real
    -- DelayModule row, trip the canonical-inheritance guard in int_execution_gpay_safe_modules, and
    -- re-break GA top-up attribution. Migrated safes keep the OLD safe's DelayModule (inherited) for
    -- GA-ownership continuity across the migration.
    WHERE p.master_copy IN (
        '0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5',
        '0x9646fdad06d3e24444381f44362a3b0eb343d337',
        '0x732b9e9f259fba6f65a1a012dc89c20872ffbd2f'
    )
),

-- The Spender is a SINGLETON, not a per-card module, so it can NEVER arrive through
-- `enabled_on_gp` above: that CTE only admits proxies enabled on an address in
-- int_execution_gpay_wallets, and the Spender is enabled on Gnosis Pay's own infra
-- safes -- 0x896a695d5ccdd21f9e3bb18307a558befccb8428 for the two live proxies,
-- 0xab270c7549a5662ce96580dcd9eb3a96046a1945 for the 2023 one. Verified: all three
-- proxies have module events, ZERO of them on a card safe. The per-card filter is
-- structurally incapable of seeing it, which is why the SpenderModule branch of the
-- multiIf above was dead code and int_execution_gpay_spender_events held 0 rows from
-- 2023-12 until this fix, taking fct_mixpanel_ga_gpay_users.spends_last_30d to 0 with it.
--
-- So register the singletons straight from factory discovery instead, keyed on the
-- mastercopy rather than on who enabled them:
--   0x70db5361... deployed 2023-12, two proxies (0x67219ab4..., 0xcff260bf...)
--   0x7a592bae... deployed 2026-06-04, one proxy (0x5f07734e...) -- the live one,
--                 emitting ~40.8k Spend events per week as of 2026-08-24
-- Both mastercopies carry a byte-identical ABI (sha256 3c5c6f3dff516d2b, 7,238 bytes),
-- so both resolve against the same 11 seeded event signatures.
--
-- This adds NO rows to int_execution_gpay_safe_modules: that model starts from module
-- events on GP card safes and INNER JOINs this registry, so a module no card safe ever
-- enabled cannot reach it. That is the guard the Delay-mastercopy note above is about --
-- it holds here for the opposite reason (never enabled on a card safe at all), not by
-- deliberate omission.
spender_singletons AS (
    SELECT
        lower(p.proxy_address)                          AS address,
        CAST('SpenderModule' AS String)                 AS contract_type,
        lower(p.master_copy)                            AS abi_source_address,
        toUInt8(1)                                      AS is_dynamic,
        p.block_timestamp                               AS start_blocktime,
        CAST('zodiac_proxy_factory_spender_singleton' AS String) AS discovery_source
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_zodiac_module_proxies') }} p
    WHERE lower(p.master_copy) IN (
        '0x70db53617d170a4e407e00dff718099539134f9a',
        '0x7a592bae57b8cd45688f9eb81ce4a622e7e37cb7'
    )
)

-- typed.address comes from int_execution_safes_module_events.target_address,
-- which is already 0x-prefixed (decode_logs writes address-typed decoded_params
-- with the prefix). Same for typed.abi_source_address from
-- int_execution_zodiac_module_proxies.master_copy. No re-prefixing.
SELECT
    address,
    contract_type,
    abi_source_address,
    is_dynamic,
    start_blocktime,
    discovery_source
FROM typed

UNION ALL

SELECT
    address,
    contract_type,
    abi_source_address,
    is_dynamic,
    start_blocktime,
    discovery_source
FROM spender_singletons

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_bala.name: int_execution_gpay_balances_user_daily
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_bala.description:
User-holdings view over int_execution_gpay_balances_daily that is
safe to aggregate across the June 2026 Safe migration without double
counting: refunded (is_lost) pairs' old-safe rows count only before
first_refund_at; non-refunded pairs have no cutover - their old safe
counts until the user moves the funds. All user-holdings consumers
(balance aggregates and fct_execution_gpay_user_balances_latest) read
this view; raw on-chain per-Safe balances remain in
int_execution_gpay_balances_daily.

date.description: The calendar date of the balance snapshot.

symbol.name: symbol
symbol.description: The token symbol for the balance.

balance.name: balance
balance.description: Native token balance.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_bala.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='view',
    tags=['production','execution','gpay']
  )
}}

-- Only refunded ("lost") pairs are cut over: their old-safe rows (all
-- tokens) count before first_refund_at and are recovery-entitled after.
-- Non-exploited pairs have no cutover - the old safe counts until the user
-- moves the funds. All user-holdings consumers (balance aggregates and
-- fct_execution_gpay_user_balances_latest) read this view; raw on-chain
-- per-Safe balances remain available in int_execution_gpay_balances_daily.

SELECT
    b.date        AS date,
    b.address     AS address,
    b.symbol      AS symbol,
    b.balance     AS balance,
    b.balance_usd AS balance_usd
FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_balances_daily') }} b
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_switchover') }} s
    ON b.address = s.old_safe
WHERE s.old_safe = ''
   OR s.is_lost = 0
   OR b.date < s.first_refund_at

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_role.name: int_execution_gpay_roles_events
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_role.description:
Decoded events from the Zodiac Roles v2 module proxies attached to GP
Safes. Includes the events Gnosis Pay actually mutates:

  RolesModSetup    — module enabled and bound to a Safe
  AssignRoles      — spender delegate assignment.
                     roleKeys (bytes32[]) and memberOf (bool[]) are
                     parallel arrays — we ARRAY JOIN them so each row
                     is one (member, role_key, is_member) triple.
  SetDefaultRole   — default role assignment for a delegate
  SetAllowance     — allowance / daily-limit creation or update
  ConsumeAllowance — allowance burn-down on a successful card spend

decode_logs returns decoded_params as a Map(String, String). Array
params are stored as JSON array strings (toJSONString of the decoded
array). ClickHouse JSONExtract* functions are 1-indexed.

ClickHouse alias-shadowing gotcha: SELECT aliases shadow source columns
in WHERE clauses, so writing `SELECT 'X' AS event_name FROM decoded WHERE
event_name = 'X'` evaluates the WHERE against the alias literal (always
TRUE). Combined with UNION ALL + ReplacingMergeTree, this would silently
relabel every row with the last-unioned CTE's literal event_name and drop
AssignRoles entirely. The AssignRoles, SetAllowance and ConsumeAllowance
CTEs all wrap their FROM in a pre-filter subquery (`FROM (SELECT * FROM
decoded WHERE event_name = 'X') d`) so the WHERE runs in a scope where
nothing shadows event_name. The pre-filter subquery is also required for
AssignRoles' ARRAY JOIN — ClickHouse evaluates the range() expression
before the outer WHERE, so without the subquery non-AssignRoles rows
reach the ARRAY JOIN with NULL roleKeys and `range(1, JSONLength(NULL)+1)`
fails with `Illegal (null) value`.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: One of RolesModSetup, AssignRoles, SetDefaultRole, SetAllowance, ConsumeAllowance.

member_address.name: member_address
member_address.description: AssignRoles `module` parameter — the address being granted/revoked the role (typically a spender delegate EOA).

role_key.name: role_key
role_key.description: AssignRoles per-element role key (one row per element from the unrolled bytes32[] array).

is_member.name: is_member
is_member.description: AssignRoles per-element memberOf flag (1 if granting, 0 if revoking).

balance.name: balance
balance.description: SetAllowance current balance (uint128, string-encoded).

refill.name: refill
refill.description: SetAllowance per-period refill (the canonical "daily limit" value).

consumed.name: consumed
consumed.description: ConsumeAllowance amount consumed by a card spend.

new_balance.name: new_balance
new_balance.description: ConsumeAllowance remaining balance after the spend.

block_timestamp.name: block_timestamp
block_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the event.

transaction_hash.name: transaction_hash
transaction_hash.description: Transaction that emitted the event.

log_index.name: log_index
log_index.description: Log index within the transaction.

{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='append',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='(roles_module_address, block_timestamp, log_index)',
    partition_by='toStartOfMonth(block_timestamp)',

    topic0 = 'ddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef'
    AND block_timestamp < today()
    AND block_timestamp >= toDate('2023-06-01')
    {% if start_month and end_month %}
      AND toStartOfMonth(block_timestamp) >= toDate('{{ start_month }}')
      AND toStartOfMonth(block_timestamp) <= toDate('{{ end_month }}')
    {% else %}
      {{ apply_monthly_incremental_filter('block_timestamp', 'block_timestamp', add_and=True) }}
    {% endif %}
{% endset %}

{% set zero_addr  = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' %}
{% set merchant   = '0x4822521e6135cd2599199c83ea35179229a172ee' %}
{% set cashback   = '0xcdf50be9061086e2ecfe6e4a1bf9164d43568eec' %}
{% set gno_token  = '0x9c58bacc331c9aa871afd802db6379a98e80cedb' %}

WITH gpay_wallets AS (
    SELECT address
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_wallets') }}
),

tokens AS (
    SELECT
        lower(address) AS token_address,
        symbol,
        decimals,
        date_start,
        date_end
    FROM {{ ref('tokens_whitelist') }}
    --WHERE symbol IN ('EURe', 'GBPe', 'USDC.e', 'GNO')
),

deduped_logs AS (
    SELECT
        concat('0x', transaction_hash) AS transaction_hash,
        CONCAT('0x', address) AS address,
        topic1,
        topic2,
        data,
        block_timestamp
    FROM (
        {{ dedup_source(
            source_ref=source('execution', 'logs'),
            partition_by='block_number, transaction_index, log_index',
            columns='address, topic1, topic2, data, block_timestamp, transaction_hash',
            pre_filter=logs_pre_filter
        ) }}
    )
),

transfers AS (
    SELECT
        l.transaction_hash,
        l.block_timestamp,
        t.token_address,
        t.symbol,
        t.decimals,
        lower(concat('0x', substring(l.topic1, 25, 40))) AS sender,
        lower(concat('0x', substring(l.topic2, 25, 40))) AS receiver,
        reinterpretAsInt256(reverse(unhex(l.data)))       AS value_raw
    FROM deduped_logs l
    INNER JOIN tokens t
        ON lower(l.address) = t.token_address
        AND l.block_timestamp >= t.date_start
        AND (t.date_end IS NULL OR l.block_timestamp < t.date_end)
    WHERE sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
       OR receiver IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
),

classified AS (
    SELECT
        transaction_hash,
        block_timestamp,
        token_address,
        symbol,
        decimals,
        sender,
        receiver,
        value_raw,
        CASE
            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND receiver = '{{ merchant }}'
            THEN 'Payment'

            WHEN receiver IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND sender = '{{ merchant }}'
            THEN 'Reversal'

            WHEN receiver IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND sender = '{{ cashback }}'
             AND token_address = '{{ gno_token }}'
            THEN 'Cashback'

            WHEN receiver IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND sender = '{{ zero_addr }}'
             AND symbol IN ('EURe', 'GBPe')
            THEN 'Fiat Top Up'

            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND receiver = '{{ zero_addr }}'
             AND symbol IN ('EURe', 'GBPe')
            THEN 'Fiat Off-ramp'

            WHEN receiver IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
            AND sender != '{{ cashback }}'
            -- AND token_address != '{{ gno_token }}'
            THEN 'Crypto Deposit'

            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets)
             AND receiver != '{{ merchant }}'
            -- AND token_address != '{{ gno_token }}'
            THEN 'Crypto Withdrawal'


            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS action,
        CASE
            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets) THEN sender
            ELSE receiver
        END AS wallet_address,
        CASE
            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets) THEN 'out'
            ELSE 'in'
        END AS direction,
        CASE
            WHEN sender IN (SELECT address FROM gpay_wallets) THEN receiver
            ELSE sender
        END AS counterparty
    FROM transfers
)

SELECT
    c.transaction_hash,
    c.block_timestamp,
    toDate(c.block_timestamp) AS date,
    c.wallet_address,
    c.action,
    c.direction,
    c.symbol,
    c.token_address,
    c.counterparty,
    c.value_raw,
    c.value_raw / POWER(10, c.decimals) AS amount,
    (c.value_raw / POWER(10, c.decimals)) * coalesce(p.price, 0) AS amount_usd
FROM classified c
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_token_prices_daily') }} p
    ON p.date = toDate(c.block_timestamp)
   AND p.symbol = c.symbol
--WHERE c.action != 'Other'
ORDER BY c.wallet_address, c.block_timestamp

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_allo.name: int_execution_gpay_allowances_current
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_allo.description:
Current allowance state per Gnosis Pay Safe.

Replays SetAllowance events from int_execution_gpay_roles_events and
keeps the latest row per (roles_module, allowance_key). Joins back to
the GP Safe via int_execution_gpay_safe_modules.

Columns are projected as Strings because the underlying decoded_params
values are Strings (decode_logs returns Map(String, String)). Cast to
numeric types in downstream marts when needed — keeping them as
Strings here avoids precision loss for uint128 balance values that
exceed UInt64.

`refill` is the canonical "daily limit" number — the amount the
allowance refills by once every `period` seconds.

balance.name: balance
balance.description: Current balance at the time of the latest SetAllowance.

refill.name: refill
refill.description: Per-period refill amount (the daily limit number).

last_set_at.name: last_set_at
last_set_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent SetAllowance event for this allowance key.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_allo.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='(gp_safe, allowance_key)',
    settings={ 'allow_nullable_key': 1 },
    tags=['production','execution','gpay']
  )
}}

WITH gp_roles_modules AS (
    SELECT gp_safe, module_proxy_address AS roles_module_address
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_modules') }}
    WHERE contract_type = 'RolesModule'
),

allowance_latest AS (
    SELECT
        roles_module_address,
        allowance_key,
        argMax(balance,         (block_number, log_index)) AS balance,
        argMax(max_refill,      (block_number, log_index)) AS max_refill,
        argMax(refill,          (block_number, log_index)) AS refill,
        argMax(period,          (block_number, log_index)) AS period,
        argMax(block_timestamp, (block_number, log_index)) AS last_set_at
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_roles_events') }}
    WHERE event_name = 'SetAllowance'
      AND allowance_key IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY roles_module_address, allowance_key
)

SELECT
    rm.gp_safe,
    a.allowance_key,
    a.balance,
    a.max_refill,
    a.refill,
    a.period,
    a.last_set_at
FROM allowance_latest a
INNER JOIN gp_roles_modules rm
    ON rm.roles_module_address = a.roles_module_address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_acco.name: int_execution_gpay_accounts_deployed
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_acco.description:
True Gnosis Pay account universe, one row per deployed account. Unlike
int_execution_gpay_wallets (payment-gated), accounts are identified by the
deploy-time on-chain signature: a Safe that enabled a Gnosis Pay Zodiac
module (Delay / Roles / Spender mastercopy), independent of whether it ever
made a card payment - so this also counts deployed-but-never-spent accounts.
June 2026 migrated Safes are collapsed onto their canonical NEW Safe (via
int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical) and keep the earliest deploy time.

account.name: account
account.description: Deployed Gnosis Pay account address (0x-prefixed, lowercase; canonical NEW Safe for migrated accounts).

deployed_at.name: deployed_at
deployed_at.description: Earliest timestamp at which this account enabled a Gnosis Pay module (its on-chain deployment/setup time).

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_acco.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='account',
    unique_key='account',
    settings={'allow_nullable_key': 1},
    tags=['production','execution','gpay'],
    pre_hook=["SET join_use_nulls = 1"],
    post_hook=["SET join_use_nulls = 0"]
  )
}}

-- True Gnosis Pay account universe, identified by the DEPLOY-TIME on-chain
-- signature: any Safe that enabled a Gnosis Pay Zodiac module (Delay / Roles /
-- Spender), independent of whether it ever made a card payment. This deliberately
-- does NOT go through int_execution_gpay_wallets (which is payment-gated at the
-- root), so it also counts accounts that were deployed but never spent -- the
-- correct basis for "accounts deployed" versus the funded/first-payment proxy.

WITH gp_module_proxies AS (
    SELECT lower(proxy_address) AS module_proxy
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_zodiac_module_proxies') }}
    WHERE master_copy IN (
        '0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5',  -- DelayModule
        '0x9646fdad06d3e24444381f44362a3b0eb343d337',  -- RolesModule
        '0x732b9e9f259fba6f65a1a012dc89c20872ffbd2f',  -- RolesModule (post-June-2026 migration)
        '0x70db53617d170a4e407e00dff718099539134f9a'   -- SpenderModule
    )
),

-- One row per GP-module-enable event, mapped to its account. The June 2026
-- post-exploit migration is collapsed here (old -> canonical NEW safe) so a
-- migrated user counts once; join_use_nulls=1 makes the unmatched right side
-- NULL so coalesce falls back to the safe's own address. No aggregation yet,
-- so the single min() below stays a one-level aggregate over raw timestamps.
account_events AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(c.canonical_address, lower(m.safe_address)) AS account,
        m.block_timestamp                                    AS event_time
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_safes_module_events') }} m
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical') }} c
        ON c.address = lower(m.safe_address)
    WHERE m.event_kind = 'enabled_module'
      AND lower(m.target_address) IN (SELECT module_proxy FROM gp_module_proxies)
)

SELECT
    account,
    min(event_time)         AS deployed_at,
    toDate(min(event_time)) AS deployed_date
FROM account_events
GROUP BY account

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_wall.description: Current owner snapshot for Gnosis Pay Safes. Thin filter over int_execution_safes_current_owners (the generic Safe ownership model) so post-setup owner mutations (AddedOwner / RemovedOwner / ChangedThreshold) are reflected, not just the creation-time SafeSetup snapshot. One row per (pay_wallet, owner) pair.

owner.name: owner
owner.description: A current owner of the pay wallet (lowercase, 0x-prefixed).

threshold.name: threshold
threshold.description: The number of required confirmations currently in effect for the safe.

block_timestamp.name: block_timestamp
block_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the event that added (or set up) this owner — i.e. the most recent SafeSetup or AddedOwner event for this (pay_wallet, owner) pair. Different semantics from earlier versions of this model, which stored the Safe's creation time here.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_dela.name: int_execution_gpay_delay_events
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_dela.description:
Decoded events emitted by the Zodiac Delay Module proxies attached to
GP Safes. Includes:

  DelaySetup       — module enabled and bound to a Safe
  TransactionAdded — admin action queued by the original setup owner
                     (the privacy-respecting "user did something admin-y"
                     signal — single most useful Delay event for analytics)
  TxCooldownSet    — cooldown configuration mutation
  TxExpirationSet  — expiration configuration mutation
  TxNonceSet       — nonce reset

decode_logs filters logs.address to (SELECT address FROM
contracts_gpay_modules_registry WHERE contract_type='DelayModule') and
joins event_signatures on the delayModMastercopy address — that's the
abi_source_address column the registry exposes.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: One of DelaySetup, TransactionAdded, TxCooldownSet, TxExpirationSet, TxNonceSet.

inner_to.name: inner_to
inner_to.description: TransactionAdded `to` address of the queued action.

inner_value.name: inner_value
inner_value.description: TransactionAdded `value` of the queued action (wei, string-encoded).

block_timestamp.name: block_timestamp
block_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the event.

transaction_hash.name: transaction_hash
transaction_hash.description: Transaction that emitted the event.

log_index.name: log_index
log_index.description: Log index within the transaction.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_dela.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='append',
    engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
    order_by='(delay_module_address, block_timestamp, log_index)',
    partition_by='toStartOfMonth(block_timestamp)',
    unique_key='(transaction_hash, log_index)',
    settings={ 'allow_nullable_key': 1 },
    tags=['production','execution','gpay', 'microbatch'],
    pre_hook=["SET allow_experimental_json_type = 1", "SET join_algorithm = 'grace_hash'"],
    post_hook=["SET allow_experimental_json_type = 0", "SET join_algorithm = 'default'"]
  )
}}
WITH decoded AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        {{ decode_logs(
            source_table         = source('execution','logs'),
            contract_address_ref = ref('contracts_gpay_modules_registry'),
            contract_type_filter = 'DelayModule',
            output_json_type     = true,
            incremental_column   = 'block_timestamp',
            start_blocktime      = '2023-06-01'
        ) }}
    )
)

SELECT
    concat('0x', lower(contract_address))                                  AS delay_module_address,
    event_name,
    decoded_params['queueNonce']                                           AS queue_nonce,
    decoded_params['txHash']                                               AS queued_tx_hash,
    decoded_params['to']                                                   AS inner_to,
    decoded_params['value']                                                AS inner_value,
    toUInt8OrNull(decoded_params['operation'])                             AS inner_operation,
    decoded_params['cooldown']                                             AS cooldown,
    decoded_params['expiration']                                           AS expiration,
    decoded_params['nonce']                                                AS nonce,
    block_timestamp,
    block_number,
    concat('0x', transaction_hash)                                         AS transaction_hash,
    log_index
FROM decoded
WHERE event_name IN (

  replace(signature,'0x','')                     AS topic0_sig,
  event_name,
  arrayMap(x->JSONExtractString(x,'name'),
           JSONExtractArrayRaw(params))          AS names,
  arrayMap(x->JSONExtractString(x,'type'),
           JSONExtractArrayRaw(params))          AS types,
  arrayMap(x->JSONExtractBool(x,'indexed'),
           JSONExtractArrayRaw(params))          AS flags

WHERE chain = 'gnosis'
  AND replaceAll(lower(contract_address),'0x','') IN (SELECT lower(replaceAll(coalesce(nullIf(cw.abi_source_address, ''), cw.address), '0x', '')) FROM `dbt`.`contracts_gpay_modules_registry` cw WHERE cw.contract_type = 'DelayModule')
 ),

process AS (
  SELECT
    l.block_number,
    l.block_timestamp,
    l.transaction_hash,
    l.transaction_index,
    l.log_index,
    l.address           AS contract_address,
    a.event_name,

    -- ABI arrays
    a.names             AS param_names,
    a.types             AS param_types,
    a.flags             AS param_flags,
    length(a.types)     AS n_params,

    -- topics and data
    [l.topic1, l.topic2, l.topic3]       AS raw_topics,
    replaceAll(l.data,'0x','')           AS data_hex,

    -- non-indexed metadata (zip flags/types/positions, then filter non-indexed)
    arrayFilter((f,t,i) -> not f,
      arrayZip(a.flags, a.types, range(n_params))
    )                                    AS ni_meta,

    arrayMap(x -> x.2, ni_meta)          AS ni_types,
    arrayMap(x -> x.3, ni_meta)          AS ni_positions,

    -- head words (32-byte) from start of the data head area
    arrayMap(i ->
      if(i*64 < length(data_hex),
         substring(data_hex, 1 + i*64, 64),
         NULL),
      range(greatest(length(ni_types), 1) * 16)  -- generous upper bound
    )                                    AS data_words,

    -- base type for arrays (strip [])
    arrayMap(j -> replaceRegexpOne(ni_types[j+1], '\\[\\]$', ''), range(length(ni_types))) AS ni_base_types,

    /* ===================== DECODING ====================== */
    -- For each non-indexed param j return a STRING:
    --  - Arrays -> toJSONString(Array(String))
    --  - Dynamic scalars -> String (hex or utf8)
    --  - Static scalars -> String
    arrayMap(j ->
      if(
        /* -------- ARRAY TYPES -------- */
        endsWith(ni_types[j+1],'[]'),

        /* Build JSON string of the fully decoded array */
        toJSONString(
          arrayMap(
            k ->
              multiIf(
                ni_base_types[j+1] = 'address',
                  concat(
                    '0x',
                    substring(
                      substring(
                        data_hex,
                        1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2,
                        64 + 64 + (k + 1) * 64
                      ),
                      (64 + k*64) + 25, 40
                    )
                  ),

                ni_base_types[j+1] = 'bytes32',
                  concat(
                    '0x',
                    substring(
                      data_hex,
                      1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2 + 64 + k*64,
                      64
                    )
                  ),

                startsWith(ni_base_types[j+1], 'uint')
                OR ni_base_types[j+1] = 'bool',
                  /* bool is stored as a 0/1 uint256 word, so we can use
                     the same reinterpret path as uint*. Output is '0' or
                     '1' (decimal string). */
                  toString(
                    reinterpretAsUInt256(
                      reverse(
                        unhex(
                          substring(
                            data_hex,
                            1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2 + 64 + k*64,
                            64
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  ),

                  startsWith(ni_base_types[j+1], 'int'),
                  toString(
                    reinterpretAsInt256(
                      reverse(
                        unhex(
                          substring(
                            data_hex,
                            1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2 + 64 + k*64,
                            64
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  ),

                /* Fallback: full 32-byte hex */
                concat(
                  '0x',
                  substring(
                    data_hex,
                    1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2 + 64 + k*64,
                    64
                  )
                )
              ),
            /* range(N) where N is array length at base */
            range(
              toUInt32(
                reinterpretAsUInt256(
                  reverse(
                    unhex(
                      substring(
                        data_hex,
                        1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2,
                        64
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        ),

        /* -------- DYNAMIC SCALARS (string/bytes/bytesN≠32) -------- */
        if(
          ni_types[j+1] = 'bytes'
          OR ni_types[j+1] = 'string'
          OR (startsWith(ni_types[j+1],'bytes') AND ni_types[j+1] != 'bytes32'),

          /* payload = hex of exactly len bytes; strings converted later */
          substring(
            data_hex,
            1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2 + 64,
            toUInt32(
              reinterpretAsUInt256(
                reverse(
                  unhex(
                    substring(
                      data_hex,
                      1 + toUInt32(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))) * 2,
                      64
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            ) * 2
          ),

          /* -------- STATIC SCALARS -------- */
          if(
            data_words[j+1] IS NOT NULL,
            multiIf(
              ni_types[j+1] = 'bytes32',
                concat('0x', data_words[j+1]),

              ni_types[j+1] = 'address',
                concat('0x', substring(data_words[j+1], 25, 40)),

              startsWith(ni_types[j+1],'uint')
              OR ni_types[j+1] = 'bool',
                /* bool is stored as a 0/1 uint256 word — same decode path
                   as uint*. Output is '0' or '1' (decimal string). */
                toString(reinterpretAsUInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))),

              startsWith(ni_types[j+1],'int'),
                toString(reinterpretAsInt256(reverse(unhex(data_words[j+1])))),

              NULL
            ),
            NULL
          )
        )
      ),
      range(length(ni_types))
    ) AS raw_values_str,

    -- Human-friendly normalization to STRING:
    -- - Arrays already JSON strings: pass through
    -- - Strings: hex → utf8 (remove NULs)
    -- - Bytes/bytesN: ensure 0x prefix
    arrayMap(j ->
      multiIf(
        endsWith(ni_types[j+1],'[]') AND raw_values_str[j+1] IS NOT NULL,
          raw_values_str[j+1],

        ni_types[j+1] = 'string' AND raw_values_str[j+1] IS NOT NULL,
          replaceRegexpAll(reinterpretAsString(unhex(raw_values_str[j+1])),'\0',''),

        ((ni_types[j+1] = 'bytes') OR (startsWith(ni_types[j+1],'bytes') AND ni_types[j+1] != 'bytes32'))
          AND raw_values_str[j+1] IS NOT NULL,
          concat('0x', raw_values_str[j+1]),

        /* else */
        raw_values_str[j+1]
      ),
      range(length(ni_types))
    ) AS decoded_ni_values,

    -- positions of indexed params (0-based positions into the param list)
    arrayMap(x -> x.3,
      arrayFilter((f,t,i) -> f, arrayZip(a.flags, a.types, range(n_params)))
    ) AS indexed_positions,

    -- stitch back into full order (correct topic index using 1-based indexOf)
    arrayMap(i ->
      if(
        param_flags[i+1],
        /* k1 is 1-based; 0 means not found */
        multiIf(
          indexOf(indexed_positions, i) = 0,
            NULL,
          param_types[i+1] = 'address',
            concat(
              '0x',
              substring(
                replaceAll(arrayElement(raw_topics, indexOf(indexed_positions, i)), '0x',''),
                25, 40
              )
            ),
          startsWith(param_types[i+1],'uint')
          OR param_types[i+1] = 'bool',
            /* Indexed bool: same reinterpret path as uint*. Output '0'/'1'. */
            toString(
              reinterpretAsUInt256(
                reverse(
                  unhex(
                    replaceAll(arrayElement(raw_topics, indexOf(indexed_positions, i)), '0x','')
                  )
                )
              )
            ),
          startsWith(param_types[i+1],'int'),
            toString(
              reinterpretAsInt256(
                reverse(
                  unhex(
                    replaceAll(arrayElement(raw_topics, indexOf(indexed_positions, i)), '0x','')
                  )
                )
              )
            ),
          /* default: bytes32/topic hash as 0x + 64 hex chars */
          concat(
            '0x',
            substring(
              replaceAll(arrayElement(raw_topics, indexOf(indexed_positions, i)), '0x',''),
              1, 64
            )
          )
        ),
        /* non-indexed: pick correct decoded value */
        decoded_ni_values[indexOf(ni_positions, i)]
      ),
      range(n_params)
    ) AS param_values,

    -- final JSON or map (all values are full strings; arrays are JSON strings)
    
      mapFromArrays(param_names, param_values) AS decoded_params
    

  FROM logs_with_abi AS l
  ANY LEFT JOIN abi AS a
    ON replaceAll(l.topic0,'0x','') = a.topic0_sig
   AND l.abi_join_address = a.abi_contract_address
)

SELECT
  block_number,
  block_timestamp,
  transaction_hash,
  transaction_index,
  log_index,
  contract_address,
  event_name,
  decoded_params
FROM process

    )
)

SELECT
    concat('0x', lower(contract_address))                                  AS delay_module_address,
    event_name,
    decoded_params['queueNonce']                                           AS queue_nonce,
    decoded_params['txHash']                                               AS queued_tx_hash,

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_spen.description:
Current spender-delegate set per Gnosis Pay Safe.

Replays AssignRoles events from int_execution_gpay_roles_events with
argMax per (roles_module, member, role_key) and keeps only the
combinations whose latest `is_member` is 1. Joins back to the GP Safe
via int_execution_gpay_safe_modules (RolesModule proxy → owning Safe).

A Safe with a Roles module that has authorized 2 spender keys produces
2 rows here. A Safe with no delegates produces 0 rows. The delegate
address is the EOA the GP card-flow infrastructure uses to trigger
spends within the user's allowance.

delegate_address.name: delegate_address
delegate_address.description: The address authorized as a spender delegate (typically a card-flow EOA).

role_key.name: role_key
role_key.description: The Roles v2 role key under which the delegate is authorized.

assigned_at.name: assigned_at
assigned_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent AssignRoles event for this (Safe, delegate, role_key).

    order_by='(gp_safe, delegate_address)',
    settings={ 'allow_nullable_key': 1 },
    tags=['production','execution','gpay']
  )
}}

WITH gp_roles_modules AS (
    SELECT gp_safe, module_proxy_address AS roles_module_address
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_modules') }}
    WHERE contract_type = 'RolesModule'
),

assign_latest AS (
    SELECT
        roles_module_address,
        member_address,
        role_key,
        argMax(is_member,       (block_number, log_index)) AS last_is_member,
        argMax(block_timestamp, (block_number, log_index)) AS last_assigned_at
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_roles_events') }}
    WHERE event_name = 'AssignRoles'
      AND member_address IS NOT NULL
      AND role_key IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY roles_module_address, member_address, role_key
)

SELECT
    rm.gp_safe,
    a.member_address                AS delegate_address,
    a.role_key                      AS role_key,
    a.last_assigned_at              AS assigned_at
FROM assign_latest a
INNER JOIN gp_roles_modules rm
    ON rm.roles_module_address = a.roles_module_address
WHERE a.last_is_member = 1

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_refu.description:
Exploit-recovery refunds credited to migrated NEW Safes by the
distributor wallets in the gpay_refund_distributors seed. Refunds
arrive days after migration completion, not at Safe deployment.
refund_date is the per-(new Safe, token) cutover used by
int_execution_gpay_balances_user_daily: from that date the paired
OLD Safe's residual balance for the token is recovery-entitled and
excluded from user-holdings aggregates.

-- Exploit-recovery refunds credited to migrated NEW Safes. Refunds are
-- sent from the distributor wallets in the gpay_refund_distributors seed,
-- in per-user amounts, days after the migration completed - NOT at Safe
-- deployment time. refund_date is the cutover used by
-- int_execution_gpay_balances_user_daily: from that date the OLD Safe's
-- residual balance for the same token is recovery-entitled and must no
-- longer count as user holdings (it would double count the refund).

SELECT
    t."to"                          AS new_safe,
    t.symbol                        AS symbol,
    min(t.date)                     AS refund_date,
    sum(toFloat64(t.amount_raw))    AS refund_amount_raw
FROM {{ ref('int_execution_transfers_whitelisted_daily') }} t
WHERE t."to" IN (SELECT lower(new_safe_address) FROM {{ source('crawlers_data', 'gp_migrated_safes') }})
  AND t."from" IN (SELECT lower(address) FROM {{ ref('gpay_refund_distributors') }})
GROUP BY t."to", t.symbol

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_spen.description:
Bridge from Spender Spend.account addresses to card-Safe identities,
one row per account ever debited by a Spender module.

Spend.account is a per-card module ENABLED ON the card Safe, not the
Safe itself (the Safe emits ExecutionFromModuleSuccess(module=account)
in the same spend transaction). The enabling Safe comes from
int_execution_safes_module_events (event_kind='enabled_module',
target_address = account); the mapping is 1:1 over full history.
canonical_safe collapses June 2026 migrated OLD Safes onto their NEW
Safe via int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical. Accounts with no enable
event (decode lag) keep safe_address NULL so consumers pick their gate.

account.name: account
account.description: Spender Spend.account address (0x-prefixed, lowercase) — the per-card account module.

safe_address.name: safe_address
safe_address.description: The Safe this account module was enabled on (latest enable event; NULL if no enable event decoded yet).

canonical_safe.name: canonical_safe
canonical_safe.description: safe_address collapsed onto the canonical NEW Safe for June 2026 migrated Safes; equals safe_address otherwise.

enabled_at.name: enabled_at
enabled_at.description: Earliest enabled_module timestamp for this account.

is_gpay_wallet.name: is_gpay_wallet
is_gpay_wallet.description: 1 if safe_address or canonical_safe is in int_execution_gpay_wallets.

-- Bridge from Spender `Spend.account` addresses to card-Safe identities.
--
-- Spend.account is NOT the GP Safe itself: it is a per-card module ENABLED ON
-- the card Safe (the Safe emits ExecutionFromModuleSuccess(module = account)
-- in the same spend transaction, and the EURe Transfer to the settlement
-- collector originates from the Safe). The enabling Safe is recovered from
-- int_execution_safes_module_events; the mapping is 1:1 (no account has ever
-- been enabled on more than one Safe, verified over full history 2026-08-24).
-- ~99.5% of accounts map to a Safe already in int_execution_gpay_wallets; the
-- rest are decode-lag or non-card Safes, kept here with safe_address NULL /
-- is_gpay_wallet 0 so consumers choose their own gate.

WITH spender_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(spend_account) AS account
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_spender_events') }}
    WHERE event_name = 'Spend'
      AND spend_account IS NOT NULL
),

enable_events AS (
    SELECT
        lower(target_address)                             AS account,
        argMax(lower(safe_address), block_timestamp)      AS safe_address,
        min(block_timestamp)                              AS enabled_at
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_safes_module_events') }}
    WHERE event_kind = 'enabled_module'
      AND lower(target_address) IN (SELECT account FROM spender_accounts)
    GROUP BY account
)

SELECT
    a.account                                                  AS account,
    e.safe_address                                             AS safe_address,
    coalesce(c.canonical_address, e.safe_address)              AS canonical_safe,
    e.enabled_at,
    toUInt8(isNotNull(w.address) OR isNotNull(wc.address))     AS is_gpay_wallet
FROM spender_accounts a
LEFT JOIN enable_events e
    ON e.account = a.account
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical') }} c
    ON c.address = e.safe_address
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_wallets') }} w
    ON w.address = e.safe_address
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_wallets') }} wc
    ON wc.address = c.canonical_address

-- collector originates from the Safe). The enabling Safe is recovered from
-- int_execution_safes_module_events; the mapping is 1:1 (no account has ever
-- been enabled on more than one Safe, verified over full history 2026-08-24).
-- ~99.5% of accounts map to a Safe already in int_execution_gpay_wallets; the
-- rest are decode-lag or non-card Safes, kept here with safe_address NULL /
-- is_gpay_wallet 0 so consumers choose their own gate.

WITH spender_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(spend_account) AS account
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_spender_events`
    WHERE event_name = 'Spend'
      AND spend_account IS NOT NULL
),

enable_events AS (
    SELECT
        lower(target_address)                             AS account,
        argMax(lower(safe_address), block_timestamp)      AS safe_address,
        min(block_timestamp)                              AS enabled_at
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_safes_module_events`
    WHERE event_kind = 'enabled_module'
      AND lower(target_address) IN (SELECT account FROM spender_accounts)
    GROUP BY account
)

SELECT
    a.account                                                  AS account,
    e.safe_address                                             AS safe_address,
    coalesce(c.canonical_address, e.safe_address)              AS canonical_safe,
    e.enabled_at,
    toUInt8(isNotNull(w.address) OR isNotNull(wc.address))     AS is_gpay_wallet
FROM spender_accounts a
LEFT JOIN enable_events e
    ON e.account = a.account
LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical` c
    ON c.address = e.safe_address
LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_wallets` w
    ON w.address = e.safe_address
LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`int_execution_gpay_wallets` wc
    ON wc.address = c.canonical_address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_spen.name: int_execution_gpay_spender_events
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gpay_spen.description:
Decoded events from the Gnosis Pay Spender module proxies attached to
GP Safes. The Spender is GP's custom final gatekeeper for card-spend
authorization (deployed and controlled by GP's settlement infra).

Events of interest:

  Spend(asset, account, receiver, amount)
      — THE event. Fired on every successful card transaction. The
        headline analytics signal for GP card activity.
            asset    — token being spent (ERC-20 contract address)
            account  — the per-card account module debited (NOT the
                       Safe itself: it is a module enabled on the card
                       Safe; int_execution_gpay_spender_accounts maps
                       it to the Safe)
            receiver — settlement / merchant-acquirer destination
            amount   — token base units (string; could be large)

  AvatarSet(previousAvatar, newAvatar)
      — Spender bound to a Safe (or rebound). The newAvatar is the
        GP Safe this Spender module belongs to. Setup signal.

  TargetSet(previousTarget, newTarget)
      — The Spender's target contract changed.

  EnabledModule / DisabledModule
      — Sub-modules of the Spender enabled or disabled (the Spender
        itself acts as a module manager for its own sub-stack).

  ExecutionFromModuleSuccess / ExecutionFromModuleFailure
      — A sub-module forwarded a call through the Spender.

  OwnershipTransferred / Initialized
      — Standard ownable / proxy lifecycle.

  HashExecuted / HashInvalidated
      — Signed-message tracking. The parameter is an unnamed bytes32
        so we cannot pluck it by key — we just record the event fired
        and leave the bytes32 in the raw decoded_params for downstream
        consumers that need it.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: One of Spend, AvatarSet, TargetSet, EnabledModule, DisabledModule, ExecutionFromModuleSuccess, ExecutionFromModuleFailure, OwnershipTransferred, Initialized, HashExecuted, HashInvalidated.

spend_asset.name: spend_asset
spend_asset.description: Spend.asset — token contract being spent (lowercase, 0x-prefixed). NULL on non-Spend events.

spend_account.name: spend_account
spend_account.description: Spend.account — the per-card account module debited (a module enabled on the card Safe, not the Safe itself; map to the Safe via int_execution_gpay_spender_accounts). NULL on non-Spend events.

spend_amount.name: spend_amount
spend_amount.description: Spend.amount in token base units (string-encoded uint256 to preserve precision).

new_avatar.name: new_avatar
new_avatar.description: AvatarSet.newAvatar — the GP Safe this Spender is bound to after the event.

module_address.name: module_address
module_address.description: Module address from EnabledModule / DisabledModule / ExecutionFromModule* events.

block_timestamp.name: block_timestamp
block_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the event.

transaction_hash.name: transaction_hash
transaction_hash.description: Transaction that emitted the event.

log_index.name: log_index
log_index.description: Log index within the transaction.

  FROM logs l
