meta.guard: One row per GT identity (registry UNION avatar). is_registered_active (registry that did an APP-TAGGED action: swaps/MetriFee/MetriTransfer/pay-topup/cashback/investment/auto-topup) is the CANONICAL GT active-user metric (~26.6k) and the replacement for the old ad-hoc is_engaged. is_registered_active_incl_circles (~40k) additionally counts GENERIC Circles actions (mint/hub/group/wrap/invitation) which carry no app tag — exposed for sizing, NOT the headline. The whole-ecosystem action total (~626k, since 2020) is NEVER a user metric.

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gnosis_ap.description:
Canonical per-identity ACTIVITY model (grain = registry UNION avatar). Records
every action signal — app-feature (swaps/cashback/investment/auto-topup/
pay-topup/referrals) AND Circles-in-app (MetriFee/MetriTransfer/HubTransfer/
PersonalMint/PrimaryGroupFee/wrap/invitation) — so "Gnosis App user" is a
configurable combination. Metri = legacy Gnosis App (app_generation). INTERNAL.
GUARD: is_registered_active (registry that did ANY action, ~27-30k) is the
canonical GT active-user metric; generic Circles actions count ONLY for
registered identities (whole-ecosystem ~626k is never a user metric).

is_registered_active.name: is_registered_active
is_registered_active.description: 1 iff a registered identity did an APP-TAGGED action (swap/MetriFee/MetriTransfer/pay-topup/cashback/investment/auto-topup) — the CANONICAL GT active-user metric (~26.6k, the plan anchor).

is_registered_active_incl_circles.name: is_registered_active_incl_circles
is_registered_active_incl_circles.description: Broad variant — also counts generic Circles actions (mint/hub/group/wrap/invitation) + referrals by a registered identity (~40k). These carry no app tag, so this over-reaches "used the app"; exposed for sizing only.

is_app_active.name: is_app_active
is_app_active.description: 1 iff the identity did any app-tagged action (swap/MetriFee/MetriTransfer/pay-topup/cashback/investment/auto-topup).

is_gp_card_user.name: is_gp_card_user
is_gp_card_user.description: 1 iff linked to a Gnosis Pay card (cashback owner or top-up funder).

is_registered.name: is_registered
is_registered.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is present in the registered-user registry (stg_envio_ga__users, ~301k). Derived as address IN (SELECT address FROM registry). Registered != active — ~53% of the registry is dormant. Gate for is_registered_active / is_registered_active_incl_circles.

has_swap_gnosis_io.name: has_swap_gnosis_io
has_swap_gnosis_io.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address was the owner of at least one CoW swap tagged with app_scope='gnosis_app' (appCode app.gnosis.io = CURRENT Gnosis App). Derived from stg_envio_ga__swaps DISTINCT owner WHERE app_scope='gnosis_app' AND owner!='' . App-tagged (unambiguous) signal; feeds current_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_swap_metri.name: has_swap_metri
has_swap_metri.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address was the owner of at least one CoW swap tagged app_scope='metri' (appCode app.metri.xyz = LEGACY Gnosis App). Derived from stg_envio_ga__swaps DISTINCT owner WHERE app_scope='metri' AND owner!='' . App-tagged; feeds legacy_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_cashback.name: has_cashback
has_cashback.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is the owner of at least one Gnosis Pay cashback NFT-mint record. Derived from stg_envio_ga__cashbacks DISTINCT owner WHERE owner!='' (cashback = the GP cashback NFT program, status enum 1=minted/0=reverted upstream; membership here is not filtered on status). App-tagged; also feeds current_app_signal and is_gp_card_user.

has_investment.name: has_investment
has_investment.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is the owner of at least one Metri auto-invest account. Derived from stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts DISTINCT owner WHERE owner!='' (join on owner, NOT account_address, which is a different address space). Treated as a LEGACY (Metri) app-tagged signal; feeds legacy_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_auto_topup.name: has_auto_topup
has_auto_topup.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is the owner of at least one Circles auto-topup CONFIG event (AutoTopupActivated/Deactivated/NewRecipient/ThresholdUpdated). Derived from stg_envio_ga__auto_topups DISTINCT owner WHERE owner!='' . NOTE: this is the auto-topup config-ledger owner, a DIFFERENT source from the has_pay_topup transfer signal. Treated as a LEGACY app-tagged signal; feeds legacy_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_referral_earned.name: has_referral_earned
has_referral_earned.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address appears as an invitee in the GA-native invite-reward ledger (i.e. this identity was invited and a reward was earned on their invite). Derived from stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite DISTINCT invitee_address WHERE invitee_address!='' . Direction gotcha: reads the INVITEE side. Generic Circles/referral signal (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and the incl_circles variant only.

has_referral_sent.name: has_referral_sent
has_referral_sent.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address appears as an inviter in the GA-native invite-reward ledger (i.e. this identity invited someone who triggered a reward). Derived from stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite DISTINCT inviter_address WHERE inviter_address!='' . Direction gotcha: reads the INVITER side. Generic referral signal (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and the incl_circles variant only.

has_metri_fee.name: has_metri_fee
has_metri_fee.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address participated in a MetriFee transfer as the from-side payer. Derived from stg_envio_ga__transfer_actions via maxIf(1, transfer_type='MetriFee')=1 (participant = `from` for MetriFee per the transfer_actions direction guard); coalesced to FALSE when the identity has no transfer_actions row. App-tagged Circles-in-app signal; feeds legacy_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_metri_transfer.name: has_metri_transfer
has_metri_transfer.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address participated in a MetriTransfer as the from-side sender. Derived from stg_envio_ga__transfer_actions maxIf(1, transfer_type='MetriTransfer')=1 (participant = `from`; note raw MetriTransfer.from is mostly a Safe address, only ~6% identity-mapped, but non-identity participants are dropped by the identity join). Coalesced FALSE if absent. App-tagged; feeds legacy_app_signal and is_app_active.

has_hub_transfer.name: has_hub_transfer
has_hub_transfer.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address participated in a Circles HubTransfer on EITHER side (HubTransfer is counted on both from and to in transfer_actions). Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type='HubTransfer')=1; coalesced FALSE if absent. GENERIC Circles action (no app tag, any Circles client) — feeds is_circles_active and incl_circles variant only, NOT is_app_active.

has_personal_mint.name: has_personal_mint
has_personal_mint.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is the minter of a Circles PersonalMint. Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type='PersonalMint')=1; coalesced FALSE if absent. DIRECTION GOTCHA: participant is the `to` side because PersonalMint.from is the zero address on 100% of rows — the minter is only on `to`. GENERIC Circles action (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and incl_circles variant only.

has_group_fee.name: has_group_fee
has_group_fee.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address paid a Circles PrimaryGroupFee as the from-side payer. Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type='PrimaryGroupFee')=1 (participant = `from`); coalesced FALSE if absent. GENERIC Circles action (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and incl_circles variant only.

has_wrap.name: has_wrap
has_wrap.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address participated in an Erc20WrapperTransfer (Circles ERC20 wrap) on EITHER side (counted on both from and to). Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type='Erc20WrapperTransfer')=1; coalesced FALSE if absent. GENERIC Circles action (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and incl_circles variant only.

has_invitation.name: has_invitation
has_invitation.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address is the recipient of a Circles InvitationFee. Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type='InvitationFee')=1. DIRECTION GOTCHA: participant is the `to` side (invitee) per the transfer_actions guard. Coalesced FALSE if absent. GENERIC Circles action (no app tag) — feeds is_circles_active and incl_circles variant only.

has_pay_topup.name: has_pay_topup
has_pay_topup.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address participated in a PayTopUp OR AutoTopup transfer (top-up funder/recipient — counted on both from and to for these types). Derived from maxIf(1, transfer_type IN ('PayTopUp','AutoTopup'))=1; coalesced FALSE if absent. This is the actual on-chain top-up TRANSFER signal (distinct from has_auto_topup, which is the config-event owner). App-tagged / Gnosis-Pay-linked; feeds current_app_signal, is_app_active, and is_gp_card_user.

is_heuristic_active.name: is_heuristic_active
is_heuristic_active.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the address appears in the legacy heuristic active-user set int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current (deduped: DISTINCT lower(address) WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND != ''). Cross-reference to the pre-GT heuristic pipeline (bundler/relayer-inferred GA usage). Treated as a CURRENT-app signal; feeds current_app_signal.

first_action_at.name: first_action_at
first_action_at.description: DateTime of this identity's FIRST on-chain transaction_action, or NULL if the identity has no row in the transaction_actions stretch table. Derived by LEFT JOIN to stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions.first_action_at = toDateTime(min(timestamp)) per lower(avatar_id). Recency enrichment only (the envio_ga entity tables carry no timestamp); avatar_id spans ALL Circles since 2020, so this is never a user count on its own.

last_action_at.name: last_action_at
last_action_at.description: DateTime of this identity's MOST RECENT on-chain transaction_action, or NULL if no transaction_actions row. Derived from stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions.last_action_at = toDateTime(max(timestamp)) per lower(avatar_id), left-joined. Recency enrichment for DAU/recency slicing; not a standalone activity flag.

n_actions.name: n_actions
n_actions.description: Integer count of this identity's total on-chain transaction_actions (all Circles action types, whole ecosystem). Derived from stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions.n_actions = count() per lower(avatar_id), then coalesce(..., 0) so identities absent from that stretch table get 0 rather than NULL. Volume/recency enrichment only — a high n_actions does NOT imply app usage on its own.

current_app_signal.name: current_app_signal
current_app_signal.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the identity shows any CURRENT (app.gnosis.io) usage: has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup. Building block for app_generation (the 'current' arm).

legacy_app_signal.name: legacy_app_signal
legacy_app_signal.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the identity shows any LEGACY (Metri, app.metri.xyz) usage: has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup. Building block for app_generation (the 'legacy' arm).

is_circles_active.name: is_circles_active
is_circles_active.description: Boolean. TRUE iff the identity did any GENERIC Circles/social action carrying NO app tag: has_hub_transfer OR has_personal_mint OR has_group_fee OR has_wrap OR has_invitation OR has_referral_earned OR has_referral_sent. These occur via ANY Circles client, so this alone does NOT mean 'used the Gnosis App' — only meaningful as app usage when combined with is_registered (see is_registered_active_incl_circles).

    order_by='(address)',
    settings={'allow_nullable_key': 1},
    pre_hook=["SET join_use_nulls = 1"],
    post_hook=["SET join_use_nulls = 0"],
    tags=['production', 'execution', 'gnosis_app_gt', 'internal_only', 'privacy:tier_internal'],
    meta={
        'expose_to_mcp': false,
        'privacy_tier': 'internal',
        'api': {'exclude_from_api': true},
        'grain': 'canonical_identity',
        'guard': 'One row per GT identity (registry UNION avatar). is_registered_active (registry that did an APP-TAGGED action: swaps/MetriFee/MetriTransfer/pay-topup/cashback/investment/auto-topup) is the CANONICAL GT active-user metric (~26.6k) and the replacement for the old ad-hoc is_engaged. is_registered_active_incl_circles (~40k) additionally counts GENERIC Circles actions (mint/hub/group/wrap/invitation) which carry no app tag — exposed for sizing, NOT the headline. The whole-ecosystem action total (~626k, since 2020) is NEVER a user metric.'
    }
) }}

-- Canonical per-identity ACTIVITY model for the Gnosis App ground-truth suite.
-- Records every action signal per identity so the "Gnosis App user" definition
-- is a CONFIGURABLE combination, not a single guess:
--   * app-feature    : swaps(appCode), cashback, investment, auto-topup config,
--                      pay-topup, referrals
--   * Circles-in-app : MetriFee, MetriTransfer, HubTransfer, PersonalMint,
--                      PrimaryGroupFee, wrap, invitation  (100% identity-mapped)
-- Metri (app.metri.xyz) is the LEGACY Gnosis App, so app_generation rolls
-- gnosis_app(current) + metri(legacy) both up to Gnosis App. Heavy scans live in
-- the two stretch staging tables; everything here reads their compact output.
WITH
identities AS (
    SELECT address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }}
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT avatar_address AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__avatars') }}
),
registry AS (SELECT address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }}),
heur AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(address) AS address
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current') }}
    WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != ''
),
sw_gio   AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__swaps') }} WHERE app_scope = 'gnosis_app' AND owner != ''),
sw_metri AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__swaps') }} WHERE app_scope = 'metri' AND owner != ''),
cb       AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__cashbacks') }} WHERE owner != ''),
inv      AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts') }} WHERE owner != ''),
atc      AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__auto_topups') }} WHERE owner != ''),
ref_in   AS (SELECT DISTINCT invitee_address AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite') }} WHERE invitee_address != ''),
ref_out  AS (SELECT DISTINCT inviter_address AS address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite') }} WHERE inviter_address != ''),
-- Circles-in-app + transfer action groups pivoted to per-participant flags
tr AS (
    SELECT
        participant AS address,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'MetriFee')             = 1 AS has_metri_fee,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'MetriTransfer')        = 1 AS has_metri_transfer,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'HubTransfer')          = 1 AS has_hub_transfer,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'PersonalMint')         = 1 AS has_personal_mint,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'PrimaryGroupFee')      = 1 AS has_group_fee,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'Erc20WrapperTransfer') = 1 AS has_wrap,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'InvitationFee')        = 1 AS has_invitation,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type IN ('PayTopUp', 'AutoTopup')) = 1 AS has_pay_topup
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__transfer_actions') }}
    GROUP BY participant
),
ts AS (
    SELECT address, first_action_at, last_action_at, n_actions
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions') }}
),
flags AS (
    SELECT
        i.address                                                  AS address,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM registry)                AS is_registered,
        -- app-feature signals
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM sw_gio)                  AS has_swap_gnosis_io,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM sw_metri)                AS has_swap_metri,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM cb)                      AS has_cashback,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM inv)                     AS has_investment,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM atc)                     AS has_auto_topup,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM ref_in)                  AS has_referral_earned,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM ref_out)                 AS has_referral_sent,
        -- Circles-in-app action signals (from the stretch transfer staging)
        coalesce(tr.has_metri_fee, false)                          AS has_metri_fee,
        coalesce(tr.has_metri_transfer, false)                     AS has_metri_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.has_hub_transfer, false)                       AS has_hub_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.has_personal_mint, false)                      AS has_personal_mint,
        coalesce(tr.has_group_fee, false)                          AS has_group_fee,
        coalesce(tr.has_wrap, false)                               AS has_wrap,
        coalesce(tr.has_invitation, false)                         AS has_invitation,
        coalesce(tr.has_pay_topup, false)                          AS has_pay_topup,
        -- heuristic cross-reference + recency
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM heur)                    AS is_heuristic_active,
        ts.first_action_at                                         AS first_action_at,
        ts.last_action_at                                          AS last_action_at,
        coalesce(ts.n_actions, 0)                                  AS n_actions
    FROM identities i
    LEFT JOIN tr ON i.address = tr.address
    LEFT JOIN ts ON i.address = ts.address
)
SELECT
    *,
    -- current app (app.gnosis.io) vs legacy app (Metri) signals
    (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)          AS current_app_signal,
    (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup) AS legacy_app_signal,
    multiIf(
        (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)
          AND (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup), 'both',
        (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup),        'legacy',
        (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup),                       'current',
        'none'
    )                                                                                    AS app_generation,
    -- app-tagged activity (unambiguously routed through Gnosis App / Metri)
    (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
     OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup)               AS is_app_active,
    -- Circles / social actions (only meaningful as app usage for a registered identity)
    (has_hub_transfer OR has_personal_mint OR has_group_fee OR has_wrap
     OR has_invitation OR has_referral_earned OR has_referral_sent)                      AS is_circles_active,
    -- CANONICAL GT active-user metric: registered AND did an APP-TAGGED action
    -- (unambiguously routed through Gnosis App / Metri — includes the app-routed
    -- Circles actions MetriFee/MetriTransfer). ~26.6k, the plan anchor.
    (is_registered
     AND (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
          OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup))         AS is_registered_active,
    -- BROAD variant: also counts GENERIC Circles actions (PersonalMint/HubTransfer/
    -- PrimaryGroupFee/wrap/invitation) + referrals by a registered identity. These
    -- carry NO app tag (any Circles client), so this OVER-reaches "used the app"
    -- (~40k) — exposed for sizing, not the headline.
    (is_registered
     AND (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
          OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup
          OR has_hub_transfer OR has_personal_mint OR has_group_fee OR has_wrap
          OR has_invitation OR has_referral_earned OR has_referral_sent))                AS is_registered_active_incl_circles,
    -- linked to a Gnosis Pay card (cashback owner or top-up funder)
    (has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)                                                      AS is_gp_card_user
FROM flags
model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gnosis_ap.compiled_code:
-- Canonical per-identity ACTIVITY model for the Gnosis App ground-truth suite.
-- Records every action signal per identity so the "Gnosis App user" definition
-- is a CONFIGURABLE combination, not a single guess:
--   * app-feature    : swaps(appCode), cashback, investment, auto-topup config,
--                      pay-topup, referrals
--   * Circles-in-app : MetriFee, MetriTransfer, HubTransfer, PersonalMint,
--                      PrimaryGroupFee, wrap, invitation  (100% identity-mapped)
-- Metri (app.metri.xyz) is the LEGACY Gnosis App, so app_generation rolls
-- gnosis_app(current) + metri(legacy) both up to Gnosis App. Heavy scans live in
-- the two stretch staging tables; everything here reads their compact output.
WITH
identities AS (
    SELECT address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__users`
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT avatar_address AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__avatars`
),
registry AS (SELECT address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__users`),
heur AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(address) AS address
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current`
    WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != ''
),
sw_gio   AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__swaps` WHERE app_scope = 'gnosis_app' AND owner != ''),
sw_metri AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__swaps` WHERE app_scope = 'metri' AND owner != ''),
cb       AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__cashbacks` WHERE owner != ''),
inv      AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts` WHERE owner != ''),
atc      AS (SELECT DISTINCT owner AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__auto_topups` WHERE owner != ''),
ref_in   AS (SELECT DISTINCT invitee_address AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite` WHERE invitee_address != ''),
ref_out  AS (SELECT DISTINCT inviter_address AS address FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite` WHERE inviter_address != ''),
-- Circles-in-app + transfer action groups pivoted to per-participant flags
tr AS (
    SELECT
        participant AS address,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'MetriFee')             = 1 AS has_metri_fee,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'MetriTransfer')        = 1 AS has_metri_transfer,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'HubTransfer')          = 1 AS has_hub_transfer,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'PersonalMint')         = 1 AS has_personal_mint,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'PrimaryGroupFee')      = 1 AS has_group_fee,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'Erc20WrapperTransfer') = 1 AS has_wrap,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type = 'InvitationFee')        = 1 AS has_invitation,
        maxIf(1, transfer_type IN ('PayTopUp', 'AutoTopup')) = 1 AS has_pay_topup
    FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__transfer_actions`
    GROUP BY participant
),
ts AS (
    SELECT address, first_action_at, last_action_at, n_actions
    FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions`
),
flags AS (
    SELECT
        i.address                                                  AS address,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM registry)                AS is_registered,
        -- app-feature signals
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM sw_gio)                  AS has_swap_gnosis_io,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM sw_metri)                AS has_swap_metri,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM cb)                      AS has_cashback,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM inv)                     AS has_investment,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM atc)                     AS has_auto_topup,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM ref_in)                  AS has_referral_earned,
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM ref_out)                 AS has_referral_sent,
        -- Circles-in-app action signals (from the stretch transfer staging)
        coalesce(tr.has_metri_fee, false)                          AS has_metri_fee,
        coalesce(tr.has_metri_transfer, false)                     AS has_metri_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.has_hub_transfer, false)                       AS has_hub_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.has_personal_mint, false)                      AS has_personal_mint,
        coalesce(tr.has_group_fee, false)                          AS has_group_fee,
        coalesce(tr.has_wrap, false)                               AS has_wrap,
        coalesce(tr.has_invitation, false)                         AS has_invitation,
        coalesce(tr.has_pay_topup, false)                          AS has_pay_topup,
        -- heuristic cross-reference + recency
        i.address IN (SELECT address FROM heur)                    AS is_heuristic_active,
        ts.first_action_at                                         AS first_action_at,
        ts.last_action_at                                          AS last_action_at,
        coalesce(ts.n_actions, 0)                                  AS n_actions
    FROM identities i
    LEFT JOIN tr ON i.address = tr.address
    LEFT JOIN ts ON i.address = ts.address
)
SELECT
    *,
    -- current app (app.gnosis.io) vs legacy app (Metri) signals
    (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)          AS current_app_signal,
    (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup) AS legacy_app_signal,
    multiIf(
        (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)
          AND (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup), 'both',
        (has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup),        'legacy',
        (has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup),                       'current',
        'none'
    )                                                                                    AS app_generation,
    -- app-tagged activity (unambiguously routed through Gnosis App / Metri)
    (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
     OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup)               AS is_app_active,
    -- Circles / social actions (only meaningful as app usage for a registered identity)
    (has_hub_transfer OR has_personal_mint OR has_group_fee OR has_wrap
     OR has_invitation OR has_referral_earned OR has_referral_sent)                      AS is_circles_active,
    -- CANONICAL GT active-user metric: registered AND did an APP-TAGGED action
    -- (unambiguously routed through Gnosis App / Metri — includes the app-routed
    -- Circles actions MetriFee/MetriTransfer). ~26.6k, the plan anchor.
    (is_registered
     AND (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
          OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup))         AS is_registered_active,
    -- BROAD variant: also counts GENERIC Circles actions (PersonalMint/HubTransfer/
    -- PrimaryGroupFee/wrap/invitation) + referrals by a registered identity. These
    -- carry NO app tag (any Circles client), so this OVER-reaches "used the app"
    -- (~40k) — exposed for sizing, not the headline.
    (is_registered
     AND (has_swap_gnosis_io OR has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer
          OR has_pay_topup OR has_cashback OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup
          OR has_hub_transfer OR has_personal_mint OR has_group_fee OR has_wrap
          OR has_invitation OR has_referral_earned OR has_referral_sent))                AS is_registered_active_incl_circles,
    -- linked to a Gnosis Pay card (cashback owner or top-up funder)
    (has_cashback OR has_pay_topup)                                                      AS is_gp_card_user
FROM flags

-- One row per CANONICAL Gnosis Pay card, flagged as controlled/funded by a Gnosis App account.
--
-- Sources (precedence, highest first):
--   1 mixpanel_pay  — Mixpanel profile `pay` property (int_mixpanel_ga_gpay_pay_bridge), the app's own
--                     record of which GA account owns which GP Safe. Pseudonym-keyed; resolved to a
--                     canonical card via the gp_pseudonym_map CTE below, which pseudonymizes EVERY known
--                     GP Safe address (current + pre-migration old) so old-address `pay` values still
--                     resolve. Module-agnostic -> survives the RolesModule migration.
--   2 delay_module  — legacy DelayModule first-GA-owner (pre-June; carried onto the canonical Safe below).
--   3 topup_funder  — a registered GA account funded the card via a Cometh-relayed top-up.
--   4 cashback      — cashback-NFT owner linked to the card.
--   (2-4 come pre-unioned from int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_card_owner.)
--
-- All cards are collapsed to their June-2026 canonical (new) Safe via int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical
-- BEFORE de-duplication, so a migrated card reachable via both a legacy Delay edge and a fresh
-- Mixpanel/Cometh edge is counted once (dup-safe). first_linked_at is the EARLIEST evidence date across
-- {legacy first_ga_owner_at, cashback minted_at, Safe safe_setup}; using the pre-June legacy date for
-- migrated cards avoids a false June "migration spike" on the cumulative chart.

WITH

canon AS (
    SELECT address, canonical_address
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical') }}
),

-- Comprehensive pseudonym map: the pseudonym of EVERY known GP Safe address (every current Safe
-- in the registry, PLUS the pre-migration OLD address of every migrated card) -> its canonical
-- card. The Mixpanel `pay` profile can still record the OLD Safe address, whose pseudonym is NOT
-- present in the shared safe_self identity (keyed only on the canonical Safe) — which previously
-- dropped ~760 Mixpanel-linked cards. Mapping BOTH address forms here makes every profile `pay`
-- value that corresponds to a known GP Safe resolve. (pseudonymize_address is injective, so each
-- pay pseudonym matches at most one map row -> no fan-out.)
gp_pseudonym_map AS (
    SELECT
        {{ pseudonymize_address('lower(w.address)') }}                                                        AS pseudonym,
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(w.address)) AS card
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_wallets') }} w
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(w.address)

    UNION DISTINCT

    SELECT
        {{ pseudonymize_address('c.address') }}  AS pseudonym,
        c.canonical_address                      AS card
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gpay_safe_canonical') }} c
    WHERE c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL
),

-- Source 1: Mixpanel `pay`-profile bridge -> canonical card via the comprehensive pseudonym map.
mixpanel_pay AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.card          AS card,
        'mixpanel_pay'  AS link_source
    FROM {{ ref('int_mixpanel_ga_gpay_pay_bridge') }} pb
    INNER JOIN gp_pseudonym_map m ON m.pseudonym = pb.pay_safe_pseudonym
    WHERE m.card IS NOT NULL AND m.card != ''
),

-- Source 2: FULL legacy DelayModule first-GA-owner set, taken DIRECTLY from the frozen model
-- (NOT via gt_card_owner, which gates the Delay signal to the envio-registered subset). This
-- guarantees the link is a strict SUPERSET of the frozen onboarding set — no known GA card is lost.
delay_full AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lower(pay_wallet) AS card,
        'delay_module'    AS link_source
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets') }}
    WHERE first_ga_owner_address IS NOT NULL AND first_ga_owner_address != ''
),

-- Sources 3-4: cashback owner + top-up funder from the on-chain bridge (its delay_module row is
-- dropped here — superseded by the ungated delay_full above).
onchain AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lower(card) AS card,
        source      AS link_source
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_card_owner') }}
    WHERE card IS NOT NULL AND card != ''
      AND source IN ('cashback', 'topup_funder')
),

all_links AS (
    SELECT card, link_source FROM mixpanel_pay
    UNION ALL
    SELECT card, link_source FROM delay_full
    UNION ALL
    SELECT card, link_source FROM onchain
),

-- Collapse each linked card onto its canonical (new) Safe.
canon_links AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, al.card) AS card,
        al.link_source                                                                                  AS link_source
    FROM all_links al
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = al.card
),

-- Highest-precedence source per canonical card.
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        card,
        link_source,
        multiIf(
            link_source = 'mixpanel_pay', 1,
            link_source = 'delay_module', 2,
            link_source = 'topup_funder', 3,
            link_source = 'cashback',     4,
            5
        ) AS rnk
    FROM canon_links
),

per_card AS (
    SELECT
        card,
        argMin(link_source, rnk) AS link_source
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY card
),

-- Candidate first-seen dates (each canonicalized to the same key space).
delay_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(w.pay_wallet)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(w.first_ga_owner_at)) AS d
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets') }} w
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(w.pay_wallet)
    WHERE w.first_ga_owner_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY card
),

cashback_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(cb.gnosis_pay_address)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(cb.minted_at)) AS d
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__cashbacks') }} cb
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(cb.gnosis_pay_address)
    WHERE cb.gnosis_pay_address IS NOT NULL AND cb.gnosis_pay_address != ''
    GROUP BY card
),

setup_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(oe.safe_address)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(oe.block_timestamp)) AS d
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_safes_owner_events') }} oe
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(oe.safe_address)
    WHERE oe.event_kind = 'safe_setup' AND oe.safe_address IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY card
)

SELECT
    pc.card                                                          AS card,
    toUInt8(1)                                                       AS is_ga_linked,
    pc.link_source                                                   AS link_source,
    -- Earliest available evidence date across {legacy owner, cashback mint, Safe setup}.
    -- NB ClickHouse LEFT JOINs use join_use_nulls=0 by default, so an UNMATCHED date column is
    -- filled with the type default toDateTime(0)=1970-01-01 (NOT NULL). Guard each candidate by a
    -- sanity floor (< 2015 => "no date") so those epoch fills don't win the least(); a card with no
    -- real date at all resolves to the 2100 sentinel -> NULL and is dropped downstream.
    nullIf(
        least(
            if(dd.d  > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), dd.d,  toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')),
            if(cbd.d > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), cbd.d, toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')),
            if(sd.d  > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), sd.d,  toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00'))
        ),
        toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')
    )                                                                AS first_linked_at
FROM per_card pc
LEFT JOIN delay_dates    dd  ON dd.card  = pc.card
LEFT JOIN cashback_dates cbd ON cbd.card = pc.card
LEFT JOIN setup_dates    sd  ON sd.card  = pc.card

-- Source 2: FULL legacy DelayModule first-GA-owner set, taken DIRECTLY from the frozen model
-- (NOT via gt_card_owner, which gates the Delay signal to the envio-registered subset). This
-- guarantees the link is a strict SUPERSET of the frozen onboarding set — no known GA card is lost.
delay_full AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lower(pay_wallet) AS card,
        'delay_module'    AS link_source
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets`
    WHERE first_ga_owner_address IS NOT NULL AND first_ga_owner_address != ''
),

-- Sources 3-4: cashback owner + top-up funder from the on-chain bridge (its delay_module row is
-- dropped here — superseded by the ungated delay_full above).
onchain AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lower(card) AS card,
        source      AS link_source
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_card_owner`
    WHERE card IS NOT NULL AND card != ''
      AND source IN ('cashback', 'topup_funder')
),

all_links AS (
    SELECT card, link_source FROM mixpanel_pay
    UNION ALL
    SELECT card, link_source FROM delay_full
    UNION ALL
    SELECT card, link_source FROM onchain
),

-- Collapse each linked card onto its canonical (new) Safe.
canon_links AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, al.card) AS card,
        al.link_source                                                                                  AS link_source
    FROM all_links al
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = al.card
),

-- Highest-precedence source per canonical card.
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        card,
        link_source,
        multiIf(
            link_source = 'mixpanel_pay', 1,
            link_source = 'delay_module', 2,
            link_source = 'topup_funder', 3,
            link_source = 'cashback',     4,
            5
        ) AS rnk
    FROM canon_links
),

per_card AS (
    SELECT
        card,
        argMin(link_source, rnk) AS link_source
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY card
),

-- Candidate first-seen dates (each canonicalized to the same key space).
delay_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(w.pay_wallet)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(w.first_ga_owner_at)) AS d
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets` w
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(w.pay_wallet)
    WHERE w.first_ga_owner_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY card
),

cashback_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(cb.gnosis_pay_address)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(cb.minted_at)) AS d
    FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__cashbacks` cb
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(cb.gnosis_pay_address)
    WHERE cb.gnosis_pay_address IS NOT NULL AND cb.gnosis_pay_address != ''
    GROUP BY card
),

setup_dates AS (
    SELECT
        if(c.canonical_address != '' AND c.canonical_address IS NOT NULL, c.canonical_address, lower(oe.safe_address)) AS card,
        toDateTime(min(oe.block_timestamp)) AS d
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_safes_owner_events` oe
    LEFT JOIN canon c ON c.address = lower(oe.safe_address)
    WHERE oe.event_kind = 'safe_setup' AND oe.safe_address IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY card
)

SELECT
    pc.card                                                          AS card,
    toUInt8(1)                                                       AS is_ga_linked,
    pc.link_source                                                   AS link_source,
    -- Earliest available evidence date across {legacy owner, cashback mint, Safe setup}.
    -- NB ClickHouse LEFT JOINs use join_use_nulls=0 by default, so an UNMATCHED date column is
    -- filled with the type default toDateTime(0)=1970-01-01 (NOT NULL). Guard each candidate by a
    -- sanity floor (< 2015 => "no date") so those epoch fills don't win the least(); a card with no
    -- real date at all resolves to the 2100 sentinel -> NULL and is dropped downstream.
    nullIf(
        least(
            if(dd.d  > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), dd.d,  toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')),
            if(cbd.d > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), cbd.d, toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')),
            if(sd.d  > toDateTime('2015-01-01'), sd.d,  toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00'))
        ),
        toDateTime('2100-01-01 00:00:00')
    )                                                                AS first_linked_at
FROM per_card pc
LEFT JOIN delay_dates    dd  ON dd.card  = pc.card
LEFT JOIN cashback_dates cbd ON cbd.card = pc.card
LEFT JOIN setup_dates    sd  ON sd.card  = pc.card

-- Guardian-module membership: current state is derived by NETTING Enabled vs
-- Disabled per (safe_address, module_address) — NOT a per-id argMax latest-state
-- mirror (DBT-D05). Recovery* labels are excluded from membership. The guardian
-- universe over-covers the 1,252 GP pay-wallets ~112x, so `is_gp_pay_wallet`
-- flags the heuristic-confirmed GP subset for reconciliation.
WITH net AS (
    SELECT
        safe_address,
        module_address,
        sumIf(1, label = 'Enabled') - sumIf(1, label = 'Disabled') AS net_enabled,
        max(event_at)                                              AS last_event_at
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__guardian_module') }}
    WHERE label IN ('Enabled', 'Disabled')
    GROUP BY safe_address, module_address
),

active AS (
    SELECT safe_address, module_address, last_event_at
    FROM net
    WHERE net_enabled > 0
)

SELECT
    a.safe_address                                                 AS pay_wallet,
    count()                                                        AS n_active_modules,
    groupArray(a.module_address)                                   AS module_addresses,
    max(a.last_event_at)                                           AS last_module_event_at,
    a.safe_address IN (
        SELECT lower(pay_wallet) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets') }}
    )                                                              AS is_gp_pay_wallet
FROM active a
GROUP BY a.safe_address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gnosis_ap.description:
Ground-truth registered-identity dimension (= dim_circles_identity, ~301k).
Registry LEFT JOIN avatar (active spine) LEFT JOIN profile. INTERNAL (raw
addresses). GUARD: never a source for active/DAU/WAU/MAU/retention
denominators — the active-user spine is the avatar table.

user_segment.name: user_segment
user_segment.description: Circles avatar segment, or registry_only_no_avatar for the ~53% dormant registrations.

circles_invited_by.name: circles_invited_by
circles_invited_by.description: Inviter address from the avatar (may be a non-registry address — relationship is warn).

has_circles_avatar.name: has_circles_avatar
has_circles_avatar.description: 1 iff the identity has a live avatar (the active spine).

created_at_block.name: created_at_block
created_at_block.description: Block number at which the registry identity was first recorded (gnosis_app_user.created_at_block, latest live value via argMax over _synced_block). Block height, not a timestamp; earliest-registration marker for the identity.

lifetime_cashback_atoms.name: lifetime_cashback_atoms
lifetime_cashback_atoms.description: Registry-recorded lifetime cashback for the identity, toFloat64(gnosis_app_user.lifetime_cashback). RAW ATOMS in the token's base units — unit/decimals are UNVERIFIED (CASH-D02), so it is NOT divided by 1e18 and must NOT be used as a decimal KPI until decimals are confirmed. From the gnosis_app_user registry only (distinct from the cashback NFT-mint table).

has_lifetime_cashback.name: has_lifetime_cashback
has_lifetime_cashback.description: Boolean: true iff lifetime_cashback_atoms > 0, i.e. the registry recorded any cashback for this identity. Derived purely from the atoms column above; independent of the has_cashback NFT-mint flag.

circles_avatar_type.name: circles_avatar_type
circles_avatar_type.description: Circles avatar type from the avatar spine (avatar.avatar_type, latest live value via argMax on the composite (_synced_block, ingested_at) version for determinism). Enum of Circles registration/avatar states: Signup, RegisterHuman, Unknown, Unclaimed, OrganizationSignup, Invite, Migrating, RegisterOrganization, RegisterGroup (may be blank). NULL when the identity has no avatar.

is_circles_early_supporter.name: is_circles_early_supporter
is_circles_early_supporter.description: Boolean flag from the avatar spine (avatar.is_early_supporter): true iff the Circles avatar is tagged as an early supporter. NULL when the identity has no avatar row (LEFT JOIN).

verification_badge.name: verification_badge
verification_badge.description: Verification-badge value from the avatar spine (avatar.verification_badge, latest live value). Indicates the identity's Circles verification-badge state. NULL when the identity has no avatar row.

accepted_invite_at.name: accepted_invite_at
accepted_invite_at.description: Timestamp the identity accepted its Circles invite, from avatar.accepted_invite_timestamp: if(ts=0, NULL, toDateTime(ts)). DateTime; NULL when the invite was never accepted (sentinel 0) or the identity has no avatar.

circles_avatar_created_at.name: circles_avatar_created_at
circles_avatar_created_at.description: Avatar creation timestamp, toDateTime(avatar.timestamp) from the avatar spine (latest live value). DateTime marking when the Circles avatar was created; NULL when the identity has no avatar.

earned_from_invites_crc.name: earned_from_invites_crc
earned_from_invites_crc.description: Cumulative invite rewards earned by this identity, toFloat64(avatar.earned_from_invites)/1e18 — DECIMAL CRC (whole tokens, 18-decimal scaled), unlike the atoms columns. From the avatar spine; NULL when the identity has no avatar.

has_profile.name: has_profile
has_profile.description: Boolean: true iff the identity has a matching live Circles profile row (coalesce(p.address,'') != ''), i.e. the registry address exists as a profile id in the deduped profile staging table. Profile presence flag.

profile_name.name: profile_name
profile_name.description: Circles profile display name for the identity, nullIf(profile.name,'') from stg_envio_ga__profiles (deduped via envio_latest; 36 version-superseding duplicate ids collapsed). Empty string mapped to NULL; NULL when no profile.

profile_location.name: profile_location
profile_location.description: Circles profile location string for the identity, nullIf(profile.location,'') from stg_envio_ga__profiles. Empty string mapped to NULL; NULL when no profile.

is_heuristic_active.name: is_heuristic_active
is_heuristic_active.description: Boolean: true iff the registry address is present in the legacy heuristic active-user set int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current (address IN (SELECT DISTINCT lower(address) ... WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND != '')). Cross-references the GT registry against the pre-existing production DAU-lineage heuristic (which is derived from int_execution_gnosis_app_user_events). Used for reconciliation/containment, not as the canonical active flag.

has_swapped_gnosis_app.name: has_swapped_gnosis_app
has_swapped_gnosis_app.description: Boolean: true iff the registry address appears as an OWNER of a swap with app_scope='gnosis_app' (address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM stg_envio_ga__swaps WHERE app_scope='gnosis_app')). app_scope='gnosis_app' means the CoW order's app_data appCode = 'app.gnosis.io' (the current Gnosis App). Direction: reads the swap OWNER (order placer), not receiver.

has_swapped_metri.name: has_swapped_metri
has_swapped_metri.description: Boolean: true iff the registry address appears as an OWNER of a swap with app_scope='metri' (appCode = 'app.metri.xyz', the LEGACY Gnosis App). Same OWNER-side derivation as has_swapped_gnosis_app but for the legacy app version.

has_cashback.name: has_cashback
has_cashback.description: Boolean: true iff the registry address appears as an OWNER in the Gnosis Pay cashback NFT-mint table (address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM stg_envio_ga__cashbacks)). Reads the cashback OWNER (mint recipient/account side). This is the NFT-mint cashback family, separate from the registry lifetime_cashback_atoms column.

has_investment.name: has_investment
has_investment.description: Boolean: true iff the registry address appears as an OWNER in the Metri auto-invest accounts table (address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts)). Reads the OWNER column (NOT account_address, which is a different address space). Legacy-app (Metri) investment signal.

is_engaged.name: is_engaged
is_engaged.description: Boolean: coalesce(act.is_registered_active, false) from the LEFT JOIN to int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity. True iff this registered identity did at least one APP-TAGGED action (gnosis_app or metri swap, MetriFee, MetriTransfer, pay-topup, cashback, investment, or auto-topup). This is the CANONICAL GT active-user metric (~26.6k), replacing the old ad-hoc 6-signal calc. false when no matching activity row (unmatched identities coalesce to false).

is_app_active.name: is_app_active
is_app_active.description: Boolean: coalesce(act.is_app_active, false) from the activity model. True iff the identity did any app-tagged action (same action set as is_engaged) REGARDLESS of registration status; differs from is_engaged only in not requiring is_registered. false when no activity row.

app_generation.name: app_generation
app_generation.description: Which Gnosis App generation the identity used, coalesce(act.app_generation, 'none') from the activity model. Enum: 'current' (app.gnosis.io signals: gnosis_app swap / heuristic-active / cashback / pay-topup), 'legacy' (Metri signals: metri swap / MetriFee / MetriTransfer / investment / auto-topup), 'both' (satisfies current AND legacy signal sets), or 'none' (neither / no activity row). Metri is the legacy Gnosis App, so both current and legacy roll up to Gnosis App.

last_action_at.name: last_action_at
last_action_at.description: Timestamp of the identity's most recent on-chain action, act.last_action_at passed through from the activity model (originating from stg_envio_ga__transaction_actions, the per-avatar action feed). DateTime; NULL when the identity has no matching activity row / no recorded action (NOT coalesced).

-- Ground-truth registered-identity dimension (= dim_circles_identity).
-- Registry (gnosis_app_user) LEFT JOIN avatar (spine) LEFT JOIN profile, plus
-- per-source engagement flags. `is_engaged` (~26.6k) is now sourced from the
-- CANONICAL activity model int_..._user_activity (registered + any app-tagged
-- action, incl. MetriFee/MetriTransfer), replacing the old ad-hoc 6-signal calc.
-- app_generation: Metri = legacy Gnosis App. app_scope on swaps separates the
-- current Gnosis App (gnosis_app) from Metri (legacy).
SELECT
    d.*,
    coalesce(act.is_registered_active, false)                     AS is_engaged,
    coalesce(act.is_app_active, false)                            AS is_app_active,
    coalesce(act.app_generation, 'none')                          AS app_generation,
    act.last_action_at                                            AS last_action_at
FROM (
    SELECT
        u.address                                                     AS address,
        u.created_at_block,
        u.lifetime_cashback_atoms,
        u.lifetime_cashback_atoms > 0                                 AS has_lifetime_cashback,
        coalesce(a.avatar_address, '') != ''                          AS has_circles_avatar,
        a.avatar_type                                                 AS circles_avatar_type,
        a.is_early_supporter                                          AS is_circles_early_supporter,
        a.verification_badge,
        nullIf(a.invited_by, '')                                      AS circles_invited_by,
        a.accepted_invite_at,
        a.created_at                                                  AS circles_avatar_created_at,
        a.earned_from_invites_crc,
        coalesce(p.address, '') != ''                                 AS has_profile,
        nullIf(p.profile_name, '')                                    AS profile_name,
        nullIf(p.profile_location, '')                                AS profile_location,
        multiIf(
            coalesce(a.avatar_address, '') = '', 'registry_only_no_avatar',
            coalesce(a.avatar_type, '')    = '', 'avatar_blank_type',
            a.avatar_type
        )                                                             AS user_segment,
        u.address IN (SELECT DISTINCT lower(address) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current') }}
                      WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != '')     AS is_heuristic_active,
        u.address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__swaps') }} WHERE app_scope = 'gnosis_app') AS has_swapped_gnosis_app,
        u.address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__swaps') }} WHERE app_scope = 'metri')      AS has_swapped_metri,
        u.address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__cashbacks') }})            AS has_cashback,
        u.address IN (SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts') }})  AS has_investment
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }} u
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__avatars') }}  a ON u.address = a.avatar_address
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__profiles') }} p ON u.address = p.address
) d
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }} act ON d.address = act.address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_execution_gnosis_ap.description: Aggregate-only reconciliation snapshot (public). registered (GT registry) vs active (heuristic) containment; cutover gate registry_containment >= 0.90.

gt_registry_users.name: gt_registry_users
gt_registry_users.description: Total distinct Circles identities in the envio_ga registry (stg_envio_ga__users = deduped envio_ga.gnosis_app_user via envio_latest). ~301k. This is the ecosystem-wide REGISTERED identity universe (one row per address, tombstoned ids removed), NOT a users/active metric. Unit: identity count. Derived as (SELECT count() FROM stg_envio_ga__users).

gt_avatar_users.name: gt_avatar_users
gt_avatar_users.description: Total distinct Circles avatar identities in the envio_ga avatar table (stg_envio_ga__avatars = deduped envio_ga.avatar via envio_latest with composite version). This is the active-user CONTAINMENT SPINE for the heuristic (broader membership than the registry). Unit: identity count. Derived as (SELECT count() FROM stg_envio_ga__avatars).

gt_registered_active.name: gt_registered_active
gt_registered_active.description: CANONICAL GT active-user count (~26.6k): number of rows in int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity where is_registered_active is TRUE = a registered identity that performed at least one APP-TAGGED action (gnosis.io or Metri swap, MetriFee, MetriTransfer, pay-topup, cashback, investment, auto-topup config). This is the headline Gnosis App active-user metric. Unit: user count. Derived as countIf(is_registered_active).

gt_registered_active_incl_circles.name: gt_registered_active_incl_circles
gt_registered_active_incl_circles.description: BROADER (sizing-only, NOT headline) active-user count (~40k): rows where is_registered_active_incl_circles is TRUE = registered identity with any app-tagged action OR any GENERIC untagged Circles/social action (PersonalMint, HubTransfer, PrimaryGroupFee, Erc20WrapperTransfer/wrap, InvitationFee, referral earned/sent). Because generic Circles actions can originate from any Circles client (no app tag), this OVER-reaches 'used the Gnosis App'. Unit: user count. Derived as countIf(is_registered_active_incl_circles).

gt_active_in_heuristic.name: gt_active_in_heuristic
gt_active_in_heuristic.description: Number of canonical GT active users that the legacy address heuristic ALSO sees: countIf(is_registered_active AND is_heuristic_active). is_heuristic_active (upstream) = identity present in int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current. Measures the overlap/recall of the heuristic against the GT active set. Unit: user count.

gt_active_missed_by_heuristic.name: gt_active_missed_by_heuristic
gt_active_missed_by_heuristic.description: Number of canonical GT active users the current-app heuristic CANNOT see (blind spot, ~17.5k): countIf(is_registered_active AND NOT is_heuristic_active). These are largely legacy/non-current-app users invisible to the current-app-only heuristic. Complement of gt_active_in_heuristic within gt_registered_active. Unit: user count.

gt_active_legacy_only.name: gt_active_legacy_only
gt_active_legacy_only.description: Number of canonical GT active users whose activity is purely LEGACY (Metri) with no current-app footprint: countIf(is_registered_active AND legacy_app_signal AND NOT current_app_signal). Upstream legacy_app_signal = has_swap_metri OR has_metri_fee OR has_metri_transfer OR has_investment OR has_auto_topup; current_app_signal = has_swap_gnosis_io OR is_heuristic_active OR has_cashback OR has_pay_topup. Isolates users the current-app heuristic structurally misses because they only ever used the legacy app. Unit: user count.

heuristic_in_registry.name: heuristic_in_registry
heuristic_in_registry.description: Number of heuristic addresses that are also present in the GT registry: countIf(addr IN (SELECT address FROM stg_envio_ga__users)) over the heur set. Numerator of registry_containment. Registry addresses are already lowercased upstream so the lower(address) heur side matches. Unit: user count.

heuristic_in_avatar.name: heuristic_in_avatar
heuristic_in_avatar.description: Number of heuristic addresses that are also present in the GT avatar spine: countIf(addr IN (SELECT avatar_address FROM stg_envio_ga__avatars)) over the heur set. Numerator of avatar_containment; expected near-total (~99.98%) because the avatar table is the active-user containment spine. Unit: user count.

heuristic_only_vs_registry.name: heuristic_only_vs_registry
heuristic_only_vs_registry.description: Heuristic addresses NOT found in the GT registry: heuristic_users - heuristic_in_registry. The residual/uncontained tail of the heuristic relative to the registry (heuristic hits with no registered Circles identity). Unit: user count. Non-negative by construction.

active_vs_heuristic_ratio.name: active_vs_heuristic_ratio
active_vs_heuristic_ratio.description: Ratio of the canonical GT active-user count to the heuristic user count: round(gt_registered_active / heuristic_users, 4). >1 means the GT active set is larger than what the heuristic captures (sizing the heuristic's under-count vs ground truth); can exceed 1. Gotcha: unguarded division -> NaN/Inf if heuristic_users = 0. Unit: ratio (dimensionless).

-- Aggregate-only reconciliation (no addresses -> public).
--   registry (301k) = the raw Circles-identity registry (ecosystem-wide; NOT users).
--   gt_registered_active (~26.6k) = the CANONICAL GT active-user metric from
--     int_..._user_activity (registered + any APP-TAGGED action incl. MetriFee/
--     MetriTransfer); gt_registered_active_incl_circles (~40k) adds generic
--     Circles actions (no app tag) — sizing only. gt_active_missed_by_heuristic
--     (~17.5k) = legacy/non-current users the current-app heuristic can't see.
--   the ACTIVE-user containment spine is the avatar table (NOT the registry).
-- Gate: registry_containment >= 0.90; avatar_containment ~1.0 (99.98%).
WITH heur AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(address) AS addr
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_users_current') }}
    WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != ''
),
counted AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT count() FROM heur)                                          AS heuristic_users,
        (SELECT count() FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }})              AS gt_registry_users,
        (SELECT count() FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__avatars') }})            AS gt_avatar_users,
        -- canonical GT active-user metrics from the activity model (registered +
        -- any app-tagged action = 26.6k; incl-circles broad variant = 40k)
        (SELECT countIf(is_registered_active) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }})               AS gt_registered_active,
        (SELECT countIf(is_registered_active_incl_circles) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }})  AS gt_registered_active_incl_circles,
        (SELECT countIf(is_registered_active AND is_heuristic_active) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }})     AS gt_active_in_heuristic,
        (SELECT countIf(is_registered_active AND NOT is_heuristic_active) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }}) AS gt_active_missed_by_heuristic,
        (SELECT countIf(is_registered_active AND legacy_app_signal AND NOT current_app_signal) FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }}) AS gt_active_legacy_only,
        countIf(addr IN (SELECT address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }}))          AS heuristic_in_registry,
        countIf(addr IN (SELECT avatar_address FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__avatars') }})) AS heuristic_in_avatar
    FROM heur
)
SELECT
    heuristic_users,
    gt_registry_users,
    gt_avatar_users,
    gt_registered_active,
    gt_registered_active_incl_circles,
    gt_active_in_heuristic,
    gt_active_missed_by_heuristic,
    gt_active_legacy_only,
    heuristic_in_registry,
    heuristic_in_avatar,
    heuristic_users - heuristic_in_registry                       AS heuristic_only_vs_registry,
    round(heuristic_in_registry / heuristic_users, 4)             AS registry_containment,
    round(heuristic_in_avatar   / heuristic_users, 4)             AS avatar_containment,
    round(gt_registered_active  / heuristic_users, 4)             AS active_vs_heuristic_ratio
FROM counted

-- WALLET METRICS: the per-identity analytical rollup the _gt sector was missing.
-- Spine = the canonical activity model (flags + first/last action ts + generation);
-- enriched with per-action-type COUNTS from the compact staging (no new heavy
-- scan), trust-graph degree + referral rewards from the avatar/invite ledgers, and
-- derived lifecycle + engagement segments. Money is limited to the two decode-
-- validated CRC fields; balances/revenue are the P0-gated follow-on.
WITH
tr AS (
    SELECT participant AS address,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type = 'MetriTransfer')              AS n_metri_transfer,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type = 'MetriFee')                   AS n_metri_fee,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type = 'HubTransfer')                AS n_hub_transfer,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type = 'PersonalMint')               AS n_personal_mint,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type = 'PrimaryGroupFee')            AS n_group_fee,
        sumIf(n_events, transfer_type IN ('PayTopUp', 'AutoTopup'))   AS n_pay_topup,
        sum(n_events)                                                 AS n_transfer_events
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__transfer_actions') }}
    GROUP BY participant
),
sw AS (
    SELECT owner AS address,
        countIf(app_scope = 'gnosis_app') AS n_swaps_gnosis_app,
        countIf(app_scope = 'metri')      AS n_swaps_metri
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__swaps') }}
    WHERE owner != '' AND app_scope IN ('gnosis_app', 'metri')
    GROUP BY owner
),
cb  AS (SELECT owner AS address, count() AS n_cashback   FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__cashbacks') }}           WHERE owner != '' GROUP BY owner),
inv AS (SELECT owner AS address, count() AS n_investment FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__investment_accounts') }} WHERE owner != '' GROUP BY owner),
ref AS (
    SELECT inviter_address AS address,
        uniqExact(invitee_address) AS n_invitees,
        sum(amount_crc)            AS referral_crc_earned
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite') }}
    WHERE inviter_address != ''
    GROUP BY inviter_address
),
av AS (
    SELECT avatar_address AS address, trusts_given, trusts_received, trusts_mutual,
           earned_from_invites_crc, circles_version
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__avatars') }}
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        a.address                AS address,
        a.app_generation         AS app_generation,
        a.is_registered          AS is_registered,
        a.is_registered_active   AS is_registered_active,
        a.is_app_active          AS is_app_active,
        a.is_gp_card_user        AS is_gp_card_user,
        a.is_heuristic_active    AS is_heuristic_active,
        a.first_action_at        AS first_action_at,
        a.last_action_at         AS last_action_at,
        a.n_actions              AS n_actions,
        -- lifecycle (real on-chain time from transaction_action.timestamp)
        dateDiff('day', a.first_action_at, a.last_action_at)                          AS tenure_days,
        dateDiff('day', a.last_action_at, now())                                      AS days_since_last_action,
        coalesce(a.last_action_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY, false)                  AS is_active_30d,
        coalesce(a.last_action_at >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, false)                  AS is_active_90d,
        toStartOfMonth(a.first_action_at)                                             AS acquisition_cohort_month,
        -- engagement counts
        coalesce(sw.n_swaps_gnosis_app, 0)  AS n_swaps_gnosis_app,
        coalesce(sw.n_swaps_metri, 0)       AS n_swaps_metri,
        coalesce(tr.n_metri_transfer, 0)    AS n_metri_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.n_metri_fee, 0)         AS n_metri_fee,
        coalesce(tr.n_hub_transfer, 0)      AS n_hub_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.n_personal_mint, 0)     AS n_personal_mint,
        coalesce(tr.n_group_fee, 0)         AS n_group_fee,
        coalesce(tr.n_pay_topup, 0)         AS n_pay_topup,
        coalesce(cb.n_cashback, 0)          AS n_cashback,
        coalesce(inv.n_investment, 0)       AS n_investment,
        -- social / trust / referrals
        coalesce(ref.n_invitees, 0)         AS n_invitees,
        coalesce(ref.referral_crc_earned, 0.0) AS referral_crc_earned,
        coalesce(av.trusts_given, 0)        AS trusts_given,
        coalesce(av.trusts_received, 0)     AS trusts_received,
        coalesce(av.trusts_mutual, 0)       AS trusts_mutual,
        coalesce(av.earned_from_invites_crc, 0.0) AS earned_from_invites_crc,
        av.circles_version                  AS circles_version,
        -- breadth = number of distinct app-tagged action TYPES the wallet used
        toUInt8(a.has_swap_gnosis_io) + toUInt8(a.has_swap_metri) + toUInt8(a.has_metri_fee)
          + toUInt8(a.has_metri_transfer) + toUInt8(a.has_pay_topup) + toUInt8(a.has_cashback)
          + toUInt8(a.has_investment) + toUInt8(a.has_auto_topup)                     AS app_action_breadth
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity') }} a
    LEFT JOIN tr  ON a.address = tr.address
    LEFT JOIN sw  ON a.address = sw.address
    LEFT JOIN cb  ON a.address = cb.address
    LEFT JOIN inv ON a.address = inv.address
    LEFT JOIN ref ON a.address = ref.address
    LEFT JOIN av  ON a.address = av.address
)
SELECT
    *,
    multiIf(
        NOT is_registered_active,                      'inactive',
        app_action_breadth >= 3 AND is_active_30d,     'power',
        app_action_breadth >= 2 OR  is_active_30d,     'core',
        'casual'
    )                                                  AS engagement_tier,
    (n_investment > 0)                                 AS is_investor,
    (app_action_breadth >= 3 AND is_active_30d)        AS is_power_user
FROM base

    SELECT inviter_address AS address,
        uniqExact(invitee_address) AS n_invitees,
        sum(amount_crc)            AS referral_crc_earned
    FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__earned_from_invite`
    WHERE inviter_address != ''
    GROUP BY inviter_address
),
av AS (
    SELECT avatar_address AS address, trusts_given, trusts_received, trusts_mutual,
           earned_from_invites_crc, circles_version
    FROM `dbt`.`stg_envio_ga__avatars`
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        a.address                AS address,
        a.app_generation         AS app_generation,
        a.is_registered          AS is_registered,
        a.is_registered_active   AS is_registered_active,
        a.is_app_active          AS is_app_active,
        a.is_gp_card_user        AS is_gp_card_user,
        a.is_heuristic_active    AS is_heuristic_active,
        a.first_action_at        AS first_action_at,
        a.last_action_at         AS last_action_at,
        a.n_actions              AS n_actions,
        -- lifecycle (real on-chain time from transaction_action.timestamp)
        dateDiff('day', a.first_action_at, a.last_action_at)                          AS tenure_days,
        dateDiff('day', a.last_action_at, now())                                      AS days_since_last_action,
        coalesce(a.last_action_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY, false)                  AS is_active_30d,
        coalesce(a.last_action_at >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, false)                  AS is_active_90d,
        toStartOfMonth(a.first_action_at)                                             AS acquisition_cohort_month,
        -- engagement counts
        coalesce(sw.n_swaps_gnosis_app, 0)  AS n_swaps_gnosis_app,
        coalesce(sw.n_swaps_metri, 0)       AS n_swaps_metri,
        coalesce(tr.n_metri_transfer, 0)    AS n_metri_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.n_metri_fee, 0)         AS n_metri_fee,
        coalesce(tr.n_hub_transfer, 0)      AS n_hub_transfer,
        coalesce(tr.n_personal_mint, 0)     AS n_personal_mint,
        coalesce(tr.n_group_fee, 0)         AS n_group_fee,
        coalesce(tr.n_pay_topup, 0)         AS n_pay_topup,
        coalesce(cb.n_cashback, 0)          AS n_cashback,
        coalesce(inv.n_investment, 0)       AS n_investment,
        -- social / trust / referrals
        coalesce(ref.n_invitees, 0)         AS n_invitees,
        coalesce(ref.referral_crc_earned, 0.0) AS referral_crc_earned,
        coalesce(av.trusts_given, 0)        AS trusts_given,
        coalesce(av.trusts_received, 0)     AS trusts_received,
        coalesce(av.trusts_mutual, 0)       AS trusts_mutual,
        coalesce(av.earned_from_invites_crc, 0.0) AS earned_from_invites_crc,
        av.circles_version                  AS circles_version,
        -- breadth = number of distinct app-tagged action TYPES the wallet used
        toUInt8(a.has_swap_gnosis_io) + toUInt8(a.has_swap_metri) + toUInt8(a.has_metri_fee)
          + toUInt8(a.has_metri_transfer) + toUInt8(a.has_pay_topup) + toUInt8(a.has_cashback)
          + toUInt8(a.has_investment) + toUInt8(a.has_auto_topup)                     AS app_action_breadth
    FROM `dbt`.`int_execution_gnosis_app_gt_user_activity` a
    LEFT JOIN tr  ON a.address = tr.address
    LEFT JOIN sw  ON a.address = sw.address
    LEFT JOIN cb  ON a.address = cb.address
    LEFT JOIN inv ON a.address = inv.address
    LEFT JOIN ref ON a.address = ref.address
    LEFT JOIN av  ON a.address = av.address
)
SELECT
    *,
    multiIf(
        NOT is_registered_active,                      'inactive',
        app_action_breadth >= 3 AND is_active_30d,     'power',
        app_action_breadth >= 2 OR  is_active_30d,     'core',
        'casual'
    )                                                  AS engagement_tier,
    (n_investment > 0)                                 AS is_investor,
    (app_action_breadth >= 3 AND is_active_30d)        AS is_power_user
FROM base

-- Reusable card -> GA-account bridge. The funded/first_payment identity is the GP Safe owner
-- (relayer / exchange / GP-direct cardholder) that Mixpanel cannot see; this maps a card to the
-- human Gnosis App account(s) that actually control/fund it, so the conversion can reach a Mixpanel
-- user (and campaign). Three signals, all gated to a REGISTERED GA account:
--   delay_module  — Delay-module controller (int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets.first_ga_owner_address)
--   cashback      — cashback NFT owner linked to the card (stg_envio_ga__cashbacks)
--   topup_funder  — app top-up funder (stg_envio_ga__pay_topups, from -> card)
-- Measured ceiling: ~6.4% of recent funded cards link this way; cashback+top-ups add ~+108 beyond the
-- Delay path (the ~36k dangling cards fund from exchanges/bridges with no app identity in ANY source).

WITH reg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT address AS ga_account FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__users') }}
),

links AS (
    SELECT lower(pay_wallet) AS card, lower(first_ga_owner_address) AS ga_account, 'delay_module' AS source
    FROM {{ ref('int_execution_gnosis_app_gpay_wallets') }}
    WHERE first_ga_owner_address IS NOT NULL AND first_ga_owner_address != ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DISTINCT lower(gnosis_pay_address) AS card, lower(owner) AS ga_account, 'cashback' AS source
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__cashbacks') }}
    WHERE gnosis_pay_address != '' AND owner != ''
      AND lower(owner) IN (SELECT ga_account FROM reg)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DISTINCT card, funder AS ga_account, 'topup_funder' AS source
    FROM {{ ref('stg_envio_ga__pay_topups') }}
    WHERE funder IN (SELECT ga_account FROM reg)
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    card,
    ga_account,
    source,
    {{ pseudonymize_address('ga_account') }} AS ga_account_pseudonym
FROM links
WHERE card != '' AND ga_account != ''
