model.gnosis_dbt.api_esg_carbon_timeseri.raw_code:
{{ 
    config(
        materialized='view',
        tags=['production','esg', 'tier1', 'api:carbon_emissions_distribution', 'granularity:daily']
    )
}}


SELECT
    date,
    daily_co2_kg_mean AS value,
    daily_co2_kg_lower_95 AS lower_95,
    daily_co2_kg_upper_95 AS upper_95,
    daily_co2_kg_lower_90 AS lower_90,
    daily_co2_kg_upper_90 AS upper_90,
    
    -- Moving averages for smoothing
    AVG(daily_co2_kg_mean) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7_value,
    AVG(daily_co2_kg_lower_95) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7_lower_95,
    AVG(daily_co2_kg_upper_95) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7_upper_95,
    
    -- Month-to-date statistics
    AVG(daily_co2_kg_mean) OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfMonth(date) ORDER BY date) AS mtd_avg,
    SUM(daily_co2_kg_mean) OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfMonth(date) ORDER BY date) AS mtd_total
    
FROM {{ ref('fct_esg_carbon_footprint_uncertainty') }}

model.gnosis_dbt.fct_esg_carbon_footprin.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='table',
        partition_by='toStartOfMonth(date)',
        tags=['production','esg','carbon_emissions']
    )
}}

-- Rebuilt in full on every run, like int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption: a day's
-- values change when Ember publishes or revises a month, so no day is frozen.
-- Ends on the last day of the latest month for which Ember has published the World
-- carbon intensity (see the gate in int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption).

WITH node_country_distribution AS (
    -- Get node distribution by country and category with their carbon intensities
    SELECT
        date,
        node_category,
        country_code,
        estimated_total_nodes,
        nodes_lower_95,
        nodes_upper_95,
        carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh,
        daily_energy_kwh_mean,
        avg_power_watts_per_node,
        power_std_dev_per_node,
        daily_co2_kg_mean,
        daily_co2_kg_std
    FROM {{ ref('int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption') }}
),

-- Calculate network effective CIF from geographic distribution
network_effective_cif AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        -- Network Effective CIF = Σ(nodes_in_country × country_CIF) / total_nodes
        SUM(estimated_total_nodes * carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS network_weighted_cif,
        
        -- Weighted standard deviation of network CIF
        -- Using variance formula: Var = Σ(w_i * (x_i - mean)²) / Σ(w_i)
        -- Then std = sqrt(var)
        SQRT(
            SUM(estimated_total_nodes * pow(carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh, 2)) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) -
            pow(SUM(estimated_total_nodes * carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0), 2)
        ) AS network_cif_std
    FROM node_country_distribution
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_power_data AS (
    -- Aggregate power consumption across all categories and countries
    SELECT
        date,
        node_category,
        
        -- Node counts with uncertainty
        SUM(estimated_total_nodes) AS category_nodes,
        SUM(nodes_lower_95) AS category_nodes_lower_95,
        SUM(nodes_upper_95) AS category_nodes_upper_95,
        
        -- Energy totals with uncertainty calculation
        SUM(daily_energy_kwh_mean) AS category_energy_kwh_mean,
        
        -- Energy standard deviation (propagate uncertainty from power and node count)
        SQRT(SUM(
            pow(power_std_dev_per_node * estimated_total_nodes * 24 / 1000.0, 2) + 
            pow(avg_power_watts_per_node * (nodes_upper_95 - nodes_lower_95) / 3.92 * 24 / 1000.0, 2)
        )) AS category_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Carbon totals
        SUM(daily_co2_kg_mean) AS category_co2_kg,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(daily_co2_kg_std, 2))) AS category_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Weighted averages
        SUM(daily_energy_kwh_mean * estimated_total_nodes) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS weighted_avg_energy_per_node,
        SUM(daily_co2_kg_mean * estimated_total_nodes) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS weighted_avg_co2_per_node,
        
        -- Country count for this category
        COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS countries_represented
        
    FROM node_country_distribution
    GROUP BY date, node_category
),

network_totals AS (
    -- Calculate network-wide totals with full uncertainty propagation
    SELECT
        date,
        
        -- Total network size with bounds
        SUM(category_nodes) AS total_estimated_nodes,
        SUM(category_nodes_lower_95) AS total_nodes_lower_95,
        SUM(category_nodes_upper_95) AS total_nodes_upper_95,
        
        -- Total energy consumption with uncertainty
        SUM(category_energy_kwh_mean) AS total_energy_kwh_mean,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(category_energy_kwh_std, 2))) AS total_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Total emissions with error propagation
        SUM(category_co2_kg) AS total_co2_kg_mean,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(category_co2_kg_std, 2))) AS total_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Category breakdown for energy
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS professional_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_energy_kwh,
        
        -- Category breakdown for carbon
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS professional_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_co2_kg,
        
        -- Node breakdown
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS professional_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_nodes,
        
        -- Quality metrics
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category_nodes > 0 THEN node_category END) AS active_categories,
        MAX(countries_represented) AS max_countries_in_category
        
    FROM daily_power_data
    GROUP BY date
),

-- Add Chao-1 population estimates for comparison
chao1_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        nt.date AS date,
        nt.*,
        necif.network_weighted_cif,
        necif.network_cif_std,
        
        -- Link to Chao-1 estimates
        c.observed_successful_nodes AS chao1_observed,
        c.enhanced_total_reachable AS chao1_estimated,
        c.connection_success_rate_pct AS chao1_success_rate,
        c.reachable_discovery_coverage_pct AS chao1_coverage,
        
        -- Compare our estimates to Chao-1
        round(100.0 * nt.total_estimated_nodes / NULLIF(c.enhanced_total_reachable, 0), 1) AS node_estimate_vs_chao1_pct,
        
        -- Calculate scaling factor applied
        round(toFloat64(nt.total_estimated_nodes) / NULLIF(c.observed_successful_nodes, 0), 2) AS applied_scaling_factor
        
    FROM network_totals nt
    JOIN network_effective_cif necif ON nt.date = necif.date
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_esg_node_population_chao1') }} c
        ON c.observation_date = nt.date
),

enhanced_statistics AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        
        -- Node population metrics with bounds
        total_estimated_nodes,
        total_nodes_lower_95,
        total_nodes_upper_95,
        chao1_observed,
        chao1_estimated,
        chao1_success_rate,
        chao1_coverage,
        node_estimate_vs_chao1_pct,
        applied_scaling_factor,
        
        -- Network carbon intensity with uncertainty
        round(network_weighted_cif, 2) AS network_carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh,
        round(network_cif_std, 2) AS network_carbon_intensity_std,
        
        -- Daily energy metrics with full uncertainty bands
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_mean,
        round(total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Daily energy confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, total_energy_kwh_mean - 1.96 * total_energy_kwh_std), 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_lower_95,
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean + 1.96 * total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_upper_95,
        
        -- Daily energy confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, total_energy_kwh_mean - 1.645 * total_energy_kwh_std), 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_lower_90,
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean + 1.645 * total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_upper_90,
        
        -- Annual energy projections with uncertainty
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000, 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_mean,
        round(total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000, 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_std,
        
        -- Annual energy confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, (total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) - 1.96 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000)), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_lower_95,
        round((total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) + 1.96 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_upper_95,
        
        -- Annual energy confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, (total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) - 1.645 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000)), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_lower_90,
        round((total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) + 1.645 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_upper_90,
        
        -- Carbon emissions (primary metrics)
        round(total_co2_kg_mean, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_mean,
        round(total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Daily CO2 confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, total_co2_kg_mean - 1.96 * total_co2_kg_std), 2) AS daily_co2_kg_lower_95,
        round(total_co2_kg_mean + 1.96 * total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_upper_95,
        
        -- Daily CO2 confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, total_co2_kg_mean - 1.645 * total_co2_kg_std), 2) AS daily_co2_kg_lower_90,
        round(total_co2_kg_mean + 1.645 * total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_upper_90,
        
        -- Annual CO2 projections
        round(total_co2_kg_mean * 365 / 1000, 2) AS annual_co2_tonnes_mean,
        round(total_co2_kg_std * sqrt(365) / 1000, 2) AS annual_co2_tonnes_std,
        
        -- Category breakdowns for energy
        round(home_staker_energy_kwh, 2) AS home_staker_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(professional_energy_kwh, 2) AS professional_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(cloud_energy_kwh, 2) AS cloud_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(unknown_energy_kwh, 2) AS unknown_energy_kwh_daily,
        
        -- Category breakdowns for carbon
        round(home_staker_co2_kg, 2) AS home_staker_co2_kg_daily,
        round(professional_co2_kg, 2) AS professional_co2_kg_daily,
        round(cloud_co2_kg, 2) AS cloud_co2_kg_daily,
        round(unknown_co2_kg, 2) AS unknown_co2_kg_daily,
        
        -- Category percentages
        round(100.0 * home_staker_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS home_staker_pct,
        round(100.0 * professional_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS professional_pct,
        round(100.0 * cloud_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS cloud_pct,
        
        -- Node distribution
        home_staker_nodes,
        professional_nodes,
        cloud_nodes,
        unknown_nodes,
        
        -- Relative uncertainties
        round(100.0 * total_energy_kwh_std / NULLIF(total_energy_kwh_mean, 0), 1) AS energy_relative_uncertainty_pct,
        round(100.0 * total_co2_kg_std / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS carbon_relative_uncertainty_pct,
        
        -- Quality metrics
        active_categories,
        max_countries_in_category AS countries_with_nodes
        
    FROM chao1_comparison
)

model.gnosis_dbt.fct_esg_carbon_footprin.compiled_code:
-- Rebuilt in full on every run, like int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption: a day's
-- values change when Ember publishes or revises a month, so no day is frozen.
-- Ends on the last day of the latest month for which Ember has published the World
-- carbon intensity (see the gate in int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption).

WITH node_country_distribution AS (
    -- Get node distribution by country and category with their carbon intensities
    SELECT
        date,
        node_category,
        country_code,
        estimated_total_nodes,
        nodes_lower_95,
        nodes_upper_95,
        carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh,
        daily_energy_kwh_mean,
        avg_power_watts_per_node,
        power_std_dev_per_node,
        daily_co2_kg_mean,
        daily_co2_kg_std
    FROM `dbt`.`int_esg_dynamic_power_consumption`
),

-- Calculate network effective CIF from geographic distribution
network_effective_cif AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        -- Network Effective CIF = Σ(nodes_in_country × country_CIF) / total_nodes
        SUM(estimated_total_nodes * carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS network_weighted_cif,
        
        -- Weighted standard deviation of network CIF
        -- Using variance formula: Var = Σ(w_i * (x_i - mean)²) / Σ(w_i)
        -- Then std = sqrt(var)
        SQRT(
            SUM(estimated_total_nodes * pow(carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh, 2)) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) -
            pow(SUM(estimated_total_nodes * carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0), 2)
        ) AS network_cif_std
    FROM node_country_distribution
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_power_data AS (
    -- Aggregate power consumption across all categories and countries
    SELECT
        date,
        node_category,
        
        -- Node counts with uncertainty
        SUM(estimated_total_nodes) AS category_nodes,
        SUM(nodes_lower_95) AS category_nodes_lower_95,
        SUM(nodes_upper_95) AS category_nodes_upper_95,
        
        -- Energy totals with uncertainty calculation
        SUM(daily_energy_kwh_mean) AS category_energy_kwh_mean,
        
        -- Energy standard deviation (propagate uncertainty from power and node count)
        SQRT(SUM(
            pow(power_std_dev_per_node * estimated_total_nodes * 24 / 1000.0, 2) + 
            pow(avg_power_watts_per_node * (nodes_upper_95 - nodes_lower_95) / 3.92 * 24 / 1000.0, 2)
        )) AS category_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Carbon totals
        SUM(daily_co2_kg_mean) AS category_co2_kg,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(daily_co2_kg_std, 2))) AS category_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Weighted averages
        SUM(daily_energy_kwh_mean * estimated_total_nodes) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS weighted_avg_energy_per_node,
        SUM(daily_co2_kg_mean * estimated_total_nodes) / NULLIF(SUM(estimated_total_nodes), 0) AS weighted_avg_co2_per_node,
        
        -- Country count for this category
        COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS countries_represented
        
    FROM node_country_distribution
    GROUP BY date, node_category
),

network_totals AS (
    -- Calculate network-wide totals with full uncertainty propagation
    SELECT
        date,
        
        -- Total network size with bounds
        SUM(category_nodes) AS total_estimated_nodes,
        SUM(category_nodes_lower_95) AS total_nodes_lower_95,
        SUM(category_nodes_upper_95) AS total_nodes_upper_95,
        
        -- Total energy consumption with uncertainty
        SUM(category_energy_kwh_mean) AS total_energy_kwh_mean,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(category_energy_kwh_std, 2))) AS total_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Total emissions with error propagation
        SUM(category_co2_kg) AS total_co2_kg_mean,
        SQRT(SUM(pow(category_co2_kg_std, 2))) AS total_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Category breakdown for energy
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS professional_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_energy_kwh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_energy_kwh_mean ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_energy_kwh,
        
        -- Category breakdown for carbon
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS professional_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_co2_kg,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_co2_kg ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_co2_kg,
        
        -- Node breakdown
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'home_staker' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS home_staker_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'professional_operator' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS professional_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'cloud_hosted' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_nodes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN node_category = 'unknown' THEN category_nodes ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_nodes,
        
        -- Quality metrics
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN category_nodes > 0 THEN node_category END) AS active_categories,
        MAX(countries_represented) AS max_countries_in_category
        
    FROM daily_power_data
    GROUP BY date
),

-- Add Chao-1 population estimates for comparison
chao1_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        nt.date AS date,
        nt.*,
        necif.network_weighted_cif,
        necif.network_cif_std,
        
        -- Link to Chao-1 estimates
        c.observed_successful_nodes AS chao1_observed,
        c.enhanced_total_reachable AS chao1_estimated,
        c.connection_success_rate_pct AS chao1_success_rate,
        c.reachable_discovery_coverage_pct AS chao1_coverage,
        
        -- Compare our estimates to Chao-1
        round(100.0 * nt.total_estimated_nodes / NULLIF(c.enhanced_total_reachable, 0), 1) AS node_estimate_vs_chao1_pct,
        
        -- Calculate scaling factor applied
        round(toFloat64(nt.total_estimated_nodes) / NULLIF(c.observed_successful_nodes, 0), 2) AS applied_scaling_factor
        
    FROM network_totals nt
    JOIN network_effective_cif necif ON nt.date = necif.date
    LEFT JOIN `dbt`.`int_esg_node_population_chao1` c
        ON c.observation_date = nt.date
),

enhanced_statistics AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        
        -- Node population metrics with bounds
        total_estimated_nodes,
        total_nodes_lower_95,
        total_nodes_upper_95,
        chao1_observed,
        chao1_estimated,
        chao1_success_rate,
        chao1_coverage,
        node_estimate_vs_chao1_pct,
        applied_scaling_factor,
        
        -- Network carbon intensity with uncertainty
        round(network_weighted_cif, 2) AS network_carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh,
        round(network_cif_std, 2) AS network_carbon_intensity_std,
        
        -- Daily energy metrics with full uncertainty bands
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_mean,
        round(total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_std,
        
        -- Daily energy confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, total_energy_kwh_mean - 1.96 * total_energy_kwh_std), 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_lower_95,
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean + 1.96 * total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_upper_95,
        
        -- Daily energy confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, total_energy_kwh_mean - 1.645 * total_energy_kwh_std), 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_lower_90,
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean + 1.645 * total_energy_kwh_std, 2) AS daily_energy_kwh_upper_90,
        
        -- Annual energy projections with uncertainty
        round(total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000, 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_mean,
        round(total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000, 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_std,
        
        -- Annual energy confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, (total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) - 1.96 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000)), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_lower_95,
        round((total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) + 1.96 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_upper_95,
        
        -- Annual energy confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, (total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) - 1.645 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000)), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_lower_90,
        round((total_energy_kwh_mean * 365 / 1000) + 1.645 * (total_energy_kwh_std * sqrt(365) / 1000), 2) AS annual_energy_mwh_upper_90,
        
        -- Carbon emissions (primary metrics)
        round(total_co2_kg_mean, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_mean,
        round(total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_std,
        
        -- Daily CO2 confidence intervals (95%)
        round(greatest(0, total_co2_kg_mean - 1.96 * total_co2_kg_std), 2) AS daily_co2_kg_lower_95,
        round(total_co2_kg_mean + 1.96 * total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_upper_95,
        
        -- Daily CO2 confidence intervals (90%)
        round(greatest(0, total_co2_kg_mean - 1.645 * total_co2_kg_std), 2) AS daily_co2_kg_lower_90,
        round(total_co2_kg_mean + 1.645 * total_co2_kg_std, 2) AS daily_co2_kg_upper_90,
        
        -- Annual CO2 projections
        round(total_co2_kg_mean * 365 / 1000, 2) AS annual_co2_tonnes_mean,
        round(total_co2_kg_std * sqrt(365) / 1000, 2) AS annual_co2_tonnes_std,
        
        -- Category breakdowns for energy
        round(home_staker_energy_kwh, 2) AS home_staker_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(professional_energy_kwh, 2) AS professional_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(cloud_energy_kwh, 2) AS cloud_energy_kwh_daily,
        round(unknown_energy_kwh, 2) AS unknown_energy_kwh_daily,
        
        -- Category breakdowns for carbon
        round(home_staker_co2_kg, 2) AS home_staker_co2_kg_daily,
        round(professional_co2_kg, 2) AS professional_co2_kg_daily,
        round(cloud_co2_kg, 2) AS cloud_co2_kg_daily,
        round(unknown_co2_kg, 2) AS unknown_co2_kg_daily,
        
        -- Category percentages
        round(100.0 * home_staker_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS home_staker_pct,
        round(100.0 * professional_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS professional_pct,
        round(100.0 * cloud_co2_kg / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS cloud_pct,
        
        -- Node distribution

        round(100.0 * total_co2_kg_std / NULLIF(total_co2_kg_mean, 0), 1) AS carbon_relative_uncertainty_pct,
        
        -- Quality metrics
        active_categories,
        max_countries_in_category AS countries_with_nodes
        
    FROM chao1_comparison
)

model.gnosis_dbt.api_esg_energy_monthly.name: api_esg_energy_monthly
model.gnosis_dbt.api_esg_energy_monthly.description: The api_esg_energy_monthly model aggregates total energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) on a monthly basis, providing insights into energy usage trends for ESG reporting and analysis.

date.name: date
date.description: The first day of the month representing the aggregation period.

value.name: value
value.description: The total energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for the given month.

model.gnosis_dbt.api_esg_energy_monthly.compiled_code:

model.gnosis_dbt.int_consensus_validator.raw_code:
{{ 
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
        engine='ReplacingMergeTree()',
        order_by='(date)',
        partition_by='toStartOfMonth(date)',
        tags=["production", "consensus", "validators_balances"]
    ) 
}}

-- q_balance/avg_balance are REAL GNO: source balance is gwei-of-mGNO
-- (32 mGNO = 1 GNO), converted here at the origin via /1e9/32.
-- Consumers must NOT divide by 32 again. q_apy/avg_apy are ratios (unit-invariant).
SELECT
    date,
    q_balance[1] AS q05_balance,
    q_balance[2] AS q10_balance,
    q_balance[3] AS q25_balance,
    q_balance[4] AS q50_balance,
    q_balance[5] AS q75_balance,
    q_balance[6] AS q90_balance,
    q_balance[7] AS q95_balance,
    avg_balance,
    q_apy[1] AS q05_apy,
    q_apy[2] AS q10_apy,
    q_apy[3] AS q25_apy,
    q_apy[4] AS q50_apy,
    q_apy[5] AS q75_apy,
    q_apy[6] AS q90_apy,
    q_apy[7] AS q95_apy,
    avg_apy
FROM (
    SELECT
        date
        ,quantilesTDigest(
            0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95
        )(balance/POWER(10,9)/32) AS q_balance
        ,avg(balance/POWER(10,9)/32) AS avg_balance
        ,quantilesTDigest(
            0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95
        )(apy) AS q_apy
        ,avg(apy) AS avg_apy
    FROM {{ ref('int_consensus_validators_per_index_apy_daily') }}
    WHERE status != 'pending_queued' AND apy < 200 --outlier filter
    {{ apply_monthly_incremental_filter('date', 'date', 'true') }}
    GROUP BY date
)

model.gnosis_dbt.int_consensus_validator.name: int_consensus_validators_withdrawal_addresses
model.gnosis_dbt.int_consensus_validator.description:
Thin projection over int_consensus_validators_labels that derives the controlling
EVM address from each validator's withdrawal_credentials (concatenation of '0x'
with the trailing 20 bytes via substring(withdrawal_credentials, 27, 40)). Saves
downstream queries the substring extraction. Only rows with a 0x01-type credential
expose a withdrawal_address — older 0x00-type BLS credentials return NULL.

validator_index.name: validator_index
validator_index.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned to each validator.

pubkey.name: pubkey
pubkey.description: BLS public key for the validator.

withdrawal_credentials.name: withdrawal_credentials
withdrawal_credentials.description: Raw 32-byte withdrawal credentials from the deposit contract.

withdrawal_address.name: withdrawal_address

model.gnosis_dbt.int_consensus_validator.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='view',
        tags=["consensus", "validators", "graph_explorer"]
    )
}}

-- Thin projection that derives the controlling EVM address from a validator's
-- withdrawal_credentials. Saves downstream queries the substring() extraction.
-- 0x01 (eth1) and 0x02 (EIP-7251 compounding) credentials both encode the
-- 20-byte execution address at the same byte offset (confirmed against the
-- consensus-specs Electra beacon-chain.md: has_execution_withdrawal_credential
-- covers both prefixes, and every address-extraction call site uses the
-- identical withdrawal_credentials[12:] slice regardless of prefix). Only
-- 0x00-type BLS credentials (no execution address) return NULL.

SELECT
    validator_index
    , pubkey
    , withdrawal_credentials
    , CASE
        WHEN startsWith(withdrawal_credentials, '0x01')
          OR startsWith(withdrawal_credentials, '0x02')
        THEN concat('0x', substring(withdrawal_credentials, 27, 40))
        ELSE NULL
      END AS withdrawal_address
FROM {{ ref('int_consensus_validators_labels') }}

invariants.text: One row per (date, validator_index) for EVERY validator in that day's int_consensus_validators_snapshots_daily, including exited and zero-balance (~558k/day). A day holding fewer rows means one or more validator_index band slices silently inserted nothing; downstream per_index/dists marts then aggregate a biased cohort (2026-07 served a NEGATIVE network APY off one mostly-exited band).

balance_prev_gno and every cumulative_* column chain from the previous day via lagInFrame + prev_state from the target table. Never build a day before its predecessor exists for that band — a missing prior day makes balance_prev fall back to 0, the effective-credit formula absorbs the whole balance, and income pins at the spec cap (~35.7 APY for 56k validators on 2026-07-20) while cumulatives reset to zero.

Every apply_monthly_incremental_filter call in this model MUST pass filters_sql=range_sql — including CTEs whose source has no validator_index (network_state). The range scope applies to the target-table watermark subquery; without it the CTE watermarks off the global frontier and later-band slices compile to an empty window, inserting 0 rows while dbt reports success.

consensus_income_amount_gno <= expected_reward_cap_gno except for real slashing losses; never re-derive income from balance deltas plus reported deposits alone (post-Pectra queue-drain days break it).

model.gnosis_dbt.int_consensus_validator.description:
Daily per-(date, validator_index) consensus income fact, including exited and
zero-balance validators. Amount columns in GNO. Identifier columns (pubkey,
withdrawal_credentials, withdrawal_address, status) are joined at the API layer from
int_consensus_validators_snapshots_daily to keep this table memory-efficient.

Two deposit numbers are emitted because of the post-Pectra accounting problem:
pre-Pectra, beacon-chain deposits credited the same day they were requested. Post
EIP-7002 / EIP-7251 (MaxEB) a single execution-request can ask for up to 2048 GNO
for one validator, but the beacon chain credits it gradually through the
pending_deposits queue (churn-bounded), so a 1767-GNO request can land as ~0.01 GNO
on the request day and ~1 GNO/day for weeks afterward. The naive
income = balance_delta - reported_deposit + withdrawals - cons_net then produces
catastrophic per-day errors (~-1767 GNO on request day, large false positives on
drain days).

Fix: spec-bounded effective-credit. The consensus spec gives a closed-form maximum
reward per epoch per validator,
    base_reward_per_epoch = effective_balance_gwei * BASE_REWARD_FACTOR
                          / sqrt(total_active_effective_balance_gwei)
With Gnosis constants BASE_REWARD_FACTOR=25, SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=16, SECONDS_PER_SLOT=5
(so EPOCHS_PER_DAY = 86400 / (5*16) = 1080) and a 3x safety multiplier for
attestation + proposer + sync duties, we get
    expected_reward_cap = 3 * effective_balance_gwei * 25 * 1080
                        / sqrt(network_active_effective_balance_gwei)        (in gwei)
    effective_deposits_credited = GREATEST(
        0,
        balance_delta + withdrawals - cons_net - expected_reward_cap
    )
    consensus_income_amount_gno = balance_delta
                                - effective_deposits_credited
                                + withdrawals - cons_net
This caps daily income at the spec maximum, keeps cumulative balance-flow exact,
leaves queued-but-not-yet-credited deposits in reported_deposit until the balance
actually moves, and scales with both validator size and total network stake.
Same base_reward * sqrt(total_stake)^-1 relation used by beaconcha.in's calculator,
applied here as a validity bound on observed income rather than a forward projection.

NOT additionally capped at reported_deposit: post-Pectra, on a queue-drain day the
reported amount is 0 but the balance jumps by hundreds of GNO; capping at reported
would falsely attribute the jump to income. The spec cap alone is sufficient.
Edge cases handled: pure reward day, reported-but-not-credited, queue-drain, slashing,
and consolidation source/target all reconcile correctly.

Cumulatives use effective credits (cumulative_deposits_gno) for total_income_estimated_gno;
cumulative_reported_deposits_gno is kept alongside for audit. Incremental strategy
follows int_execution_tokens_balances_native_daily — daily deltas + balance reads
are pulled only from the incremental window, with prior-state (last balance and
cumulatives at the previous partition boundary) loaded from  so lifetime
cumulatives stay correct without scanning history. balance_prev_gno uses lagInFrame
within the window, falling back to prev_state at the partition boundary.

Known upstream limitation: consensus.validators crawler outages (observed
2025-12-10 .. 2025-12-28, 20 fully-empty days) cause withdrawals/deposits/
consolidations during the gap to have no matching snapshot, producing a large
one-day negative income on the resume day for affected validators. Documented
here so consumers know those single-day outliers are upstream-data, not formula.

date.name: date
date.description: Start-of-day UTC for the validator's daily income row.

validator_index.name: validator_index
validator_index.description: Beacon-chain validator index. Unique per date (see model-level unique_key).

balance_prev_gno.name: balance_prev_gno
balance_prev_gno.description: Previous-day balance in GNO (lagInFrame by 1 within validator_index).

effective_balance_gno.name: effective_balance_gno
effective_balance_gno.description: End-of-day effective balance in real GNO (the 1-GNO-step stake used in the reward-cap formula; the spec's 32-mGNO step equals 1 GNO).

deposits_amount_gno.name: deposits_amount_gno
deposits_amount_gno.description:
RAW reported deposit amount for the date (execution_request and beacon deposit
amounts summed per validator). Post-Pectra this is a REQUEST amount — the beacon
chain credits it gradually via the churn-limited queue, so this column may be
far larger than what actually hit the validator's balance that day. Use
effective_deposits_credited_gno for income-accounting purposes; use this column
for "when was a deposit requested" audit/display.

effective_deposits_credited_gno.name: effective_deposits_credited_gno
effective_deposits_credited_gno.description:
Spec-bounded actual deposit credit for the date (in GNO). Computed as
GREATEST(0, balance_delta + withdrawals - cons_net - expected_reward_cap) so
that it captures queue-drain days (balance jumps without a same-day request)
while ignoring request-but-not-yet-credited days. Sum over time equals the
true cumulative deposit principal for the validator.

expected_reward_cap_gno.name: expected_reward_cap_gno
expected_reward_cap_gno.description:
Consensus-spec upper bound on this validator's possible daily reward, in real GNO.
3 × effective_balance_gwei × BASE_REWARD_FACTOR (25) × EPOCHS_PER_DAY (1080)
÷ √(network_effective_balance_gwei) ÷ 1e9 ÷ 32. Anything above this in daily balance
growth is attributed to effective_deposits_credited_gno, not income. Useful for
debugging and for constructing validator-balance-weighted APY.

deposits_count.name: deposits_count
deposits_count.description: Number of deposit events (reported requests) for the validator on the date.

withdrawals_amount_gno.name: withdrawals_amount_gno
withdrawals_amount_gno.description: Sum of withdrawal amounts paid to the validator on the date, in GNO.

withdrawals_count.name: withdrawals_count
withdrawals_count.description: Number of withdrawal events paid to the validator on the date.

consolidation_inflow_gno.name: consolidation_inflow_gno
consolidation_inflow_gno.description: Consolidation amount received (target role) on the date, in GNO.

consolidation_outflow_gno.name: consolidation_outflow_gno
consolidation_outflow_gno.description: Consolidation amount transferred out (source role) on the date, in GNO.

consensus_income_amount_gno.name: consensus_income_amount_gno
consensus_income_amount_gno.description:
Consensus income on the date, in GNO. Computed as
balance_delta − effective_deposits_credited_gno + withdrawals_amount_gno
− consolidation_inflow_gno + consolidation_outflow_gno.
Capped above by the consensus-spec expected_reward_cap_gno (plus 3× safety for
attestation + proposer + sync duties); can be negative on slashing events.

apy.name: apy
apy.description: Annualized percent yield computed from daily_rate.

cumulative_deposits_gno.name: cumulative_deposits_gno
cumulative_deposits_gno.description:
Running sum of effective_deposits_credited_gno for this validator. Used by
total_income_estimated_gno and by the Validator Explorer's cumulative-flow charts.

cumulative_reported_deposits_gno.name: cumulative_reported_deposits_gno
cumulative_reported_deposits_gno.description:
Running sum of raw deposits_amount_gno (REPORTED requests) for this validator —
may exceed cumulative_deposits_gno while queued requests are still draining.
Kept for audit / display; NOT used in total_income_estimated_gno.

cumulative_withdrawals_gno.name: cumulative_withdrawals_gno
cumulative_withdrawals_gno.description: Running sum of withdrawals_amount_gno for this validator over time, in GNO.

cumulative_consolidation_inflow_gno.name: cumulative_consolidation_inflow_gno
cumulative_consolidation_inflow_gno.description: Running sum of consolidation_inflow_gno for this validator over time, in GNO.

cumulative_consolidation_outflow_gno.name: cumulative_consolidation_outflow_gno
cumulative_consolidation_outflow_gno.description: Running sum of consolidation_outflow_gno for this validator over time, in GNO.

total_income_estimated_gno.name: total_income_estimated_gno
total_income_estimated_gno.description: balance_gno + cumulative_withdrawals_gno − cumulative_deposits_gno (effective) − cumulative_consolidation_inflow_gno + cumulative_consolidation_outflow_gno. In GNO.

invariants.text: One row per (date, validator_index) for EVERY validator in that day's int_consensus_validators_snapshots_daily, including exited and zero-balance (~558k/day). A day holding fewer rows means one or more validator_index band slices silently inserted nothing; downstream per_index/dists marts then aggregate a biased cohort (2026-07 served a NEGATIVE network APY off one mostly-exited band).

balance_prev_gno and every cumulative_* column chain from the previous day via lagInFrame + prev_state from the target table. Never build a day before its predecessor exists for that band — a missing prior day makes balance_prev fall back to 0, the effective-credit formula absorbs the whole balance, and income pins at the spec cap (~35.7 APY for 56k validators on 2026-07-20) while cumulatives reset to zero.

Every apply_monthly_incremental_filter call in this model MUST pass filters_sql=range_sql — including CTEs whose source has no validator_index (network_state). The range scope applies to the target-table watermark subquery; without it the CTE watermarks off the global frontier and later-band slices compile to an empty window, inserting 0 rows while dbt reports success.

consensus_income_amount_gno <= expected_reward_cap_gno except for real slashing losses; never re-derive income from balance deltas plus reported deposits alone (post-Pectra queue-drain days break it).
